### broadcast/HOF dispatch-first closure (Issue #4019)

- #4019 の acceptance scope を current checkout で再確認し、broadcast / HOF /
  reduction の representative Array paths は Pure Julia dispatch-first path へ
  移行済みとして整理した。
- New IR no longer emits the retained Rust HOF instructions for public
  `map`, `map!`, `filter`, `reduce`, `foldl`, `foldr`, `mapreduce`,
  `mapfoldl`, `mapfoldr`, `broadcast`, `broadcast!`, or predicate reducers;
  those instructions remain classified as cache/primitive compatibility
  fallbacks.
- Remaining final native carrier cleanup is tracked by #4568 rather than

  passed 2695/2695 on the same checkout.

### scalar narrow-number flatten collect (Issue #4666)

- `collect(Base.Iterators.flatten((Int8(1), Int16(2))))` now matches upstream
  Julia by returning `Vector{Signed}` instead of erroring in scalar iteration.
- Scalar `Number` iteration in the VM now covers all native number carriers,
  including narrow signed/unsigned integers, `Float16`, `BigInt`, and
  `BigFloat`, not only `Int64`/`Float64`/`Float32`/`Bool`.
- Added fixture `iteration_flatten_narrow_scalar_collect_4666`, covering
  joined `Signed`, `Unsigned`, and `AbstractFloat` scalar flatten results.

### number eltype dynamic dispatch (Issue #4665)

- `eltype(x)` called from a generic function now preserves scalar number
  element types (`Int64`, `Int8`, `UInt8`, `Float64`, `Float32`, `Bool`) instead
  of falling through the `Eltype` builtin fallback to `Any`.
- The VM `Eltype` fallback now mirrors upstream's `eltype(::Type{T}) where
  T<:Number = T` plus value fallback behavior for native scalar number carriers.
- Added fixture `types_eltype_number_dynamic_dispatch_4665`, covering direct
  and generic `eltype` calls on scalar numbers and type objects.

### scalar flatten collect (Issue #4664)

- `collect(Base.Iterators.flatten((1, 2)))` now preserves upstream Julia's
  scalar-number materialization type, returning `Vector{Int64}` instead of
  `Vector{Any}`.
- `Flatten` now handles scalar `Number` inner values through `typeof(inner)`
  when deriving runtime eltype, while keeping the inner-iterable `eltype` join
  path added for Issue #4663.
- Added upstream-shaped number `eltype(::Type{T}) where T<:Number` coverage in
  `base/number.jl`. The dynamic `eltype(x::Number)` fallback gap found while
  fixing this slice is tracked and fixed as Issue #4665.
- A remaining narrow scalar path,
  `collect(Base.Iterators.flatten((Int8(1), Int16(2))))`, still errors in
  scalar iteration and is tracked/fixed separately as Issue #4666.
- fixture `iteration_flatten_scalar_collect_4664` covers homogeneous Int64,
  homogeneous Float64, and mixed Int64/Float64 scalar flatten collect.

### flatten mixed eltype collect (Issue #4663)

- `collect(Base.Iterators.flatten((Int8[...], Int16[...])))` now preserves
  upstream Julia's joined abstract numeric eltype, returning `Vector{Signed}`
  instead of `Vector{Any}`.
- `Flatten` now reports `HasEltype()` and computes its runtime eltype by
  joining the inner iterables' `eltype`s, covering representative `Signed`,
  `Unsigned`, `Integer`, and `AbstractFloat` mixed-vector cases including empty
  inner vectors.
- 作業中に見つけた mixed-eltype `Iterators.flatten` collect widening bug は
  Issue #4663 として報告済みで、fixture
  `iteration_flatten_mixed_eltype_collect_4663` を追加した。追加 probe で見つけた
  scalar `flatten((1, 2))` widening は Issue #4664 として別途報告済み。

### tuple collect abstract numeric eltype (Issue #4662)

- `collect((Int8(1), Int16(2)))` now preserves upstream Julia's
  `Vector{Signed}` result instead of widening to `Vector{Real}` through the
  typed undef allocation helper.
- `_array_undef_from_dims` now has explicit abstract numeric type routes for
  `Number`, `Real`, `Integer`, `Signed`, `Unsigned`, and `AbstractFloat`, so
  `Vector{Signed}(undef, n)` and related allocation helpers keep their logical
  element tags.
- 作業中に見つけた mixed narrow signed tuple collect widening bug は Issue #4662
  として報告済みで、fixture
  `array_tuple_collect_abstract_numeric_eltype_4662` を追加した。

### indexin Union result type (Issue #4657)

- `indexin(a, b)` now follows upstream Julia's `Union{eltype(keys(b)), Nothing}`
  result allocation for one-based array keys, returning
  `Vector{Union{Nothing, Int64}}` instead of `Vector{Any}`.
- `Array{Union{Nothing, Int64}}` / `Memory{Union{Nothing, Int64}}`
  allocation now preserves the logical Union element tag through both static
  constructors and `similar(Array{T}, dims)` where-parameter dispatch.
- Runtime callable dispatch now demotes non-exact `Type{Any}` matches so
  `_array_undef_from_dims(::Type{T}, dims) where T` wins for Union type
  objects, matching the typed-dispatch policy.
- 作業中に見つけた `indexin` result type bug は Issue #4657 として報告済みで、
  fixture `array_indexin_union_result_4657` を追加した。

### typed Set construction and Set/Vector set algebra (Issue #4018)

- Legacy `Value::Set` type projection now derives `Set{T}` from homogeneous
  stored elements instead of always reporting `Set{Any}`.
- Empty `Set{T}()` now emits a typed Set allocation and `SetValue` keeps an
  element-type carrier, so `typeof`, `eltype`, `collect`, and `empty!` preserve
  `T` even when there are no stored elements.
- Local `Set` assignments now store through the Set slot path, so direct
  `push!(s, x)`, `delete!(s, x)`, and `empty!(s)` calls update the original
  binding while preserving the typed carrier.
- Pure Julia `Set` algebra now keeps the returned set from `push!` / `delete!`
  helpers, so `union`, `intersect`, `setdiff`, and `symdiff` no longer leave
  their `Set()` result empty.
- `Set(Int8[...])` and `Set(Float32[...])` accept typed keys without falling
  into invalid dictionary key errors (Issue #4609).
- `union(Set(Int8[...]), Int8[...])` returns `Set{Int8}`, while the upstream
  vector-first form `union(Int8[...], Set(Int8[...]))` returns `Vector{Int8}`.
- `JuliaType::Set` now prints as the bare `Set` type rather than `Set{Any}`,
  restoring `Set{T} <: Set` and dispatch to methods declared as `s::Set`.
- 作業中に見つけた typed Set construction / Set-Vector algebra widening bug は
  Issues #4609/#4658 として報告し、fixture `collections_set_typed_operations_4658`
  を追加した。typed Set metadata で露見した bare `Set` subtype / dispatch bug
  は Issue #4660 として報告し、fixture
  `sets_parametric_set_subtype_4660` を追加した。空 `Set{T}()` が
  `Set{Any}` へ落ちる bug は Issue #4661 として報告し、fixture
  `collections_set_typed_empty_constructor_4661` を追加した。

### empty integer division binary map typed allocation (Issue #4019)

- `map(/, A::Vector{<:Integer}, B::Vector{<:Integer})` and
  `map(/, Bool[], Bool[])` now allocate `Vector{Float64}` even when the
  shortest input length is zero, matching upstream Julia's inferred result
  eltype for empty mapped results.
- The existing non-empty binary map path already samples the first mapped value;
  this adds singleton-function specializations for `/` so empty inputs no
  longer fall back to `similar(A, 0)` with the input element type.
- 作業中に見つけた `map(/, Int8[], Int8[])` が `Vector{Int8}` になる bug は
  Issue #4659 として報告し、fixture
  `hof_map_binary_type_preservation_4610` に regression coverage を追加した。

### permutedims no-perm typed allocation (Issue #4018)

- `permutedims(arr)` without an explicit permutation now allocates through
  `similar(arr, ...)` for both vector row conversion and 2D transpose,
  removing the old typed flat-buffer special cases plus `Any[]` fallback.
- `permutedims(Int8[...])` / `permutedims(Matrix{Int8})` now return
  `Matrix{Int8}`, and `Float32` inputs return `Matrix{Float32}`, matching
  upstream Julia result eltypes.
- 作業中に no-perm `permutedims` が `Int8` / `Float32` inputs を
  `Matrix{Any}` に広げる bug は Issue #4656 として報告し、fixture
  `array_permutedims_type_preservation` に regression coverage を追加した。

### hcat/vcat mixed eltype promotion (Issue #4018)

- `hcat` / `vcat` の mixed vector result allocation を upstream Julia の
  `promote_eltype` 方針に合わせ、input vector の `eltype` を `promote_type`
  で畳み込んだ typed container allocation へ移した。
- `hcat(Int8[...], Int16[...])` は `Matrix{Int16}`、
  `hcat(Int8[...], Float32[...])` は `Matrix{Float32}`、
  `vcat(Int8[...], Int16[...])` は `Vector{Int16}`、
  `vcat(Int8[...], Float32[...])` は `Vector{Float32}` を返す。
- 作業中に mixed `hcat` が `Matrix{Any}`、mixed `vcat` が first input
  eltype に落ちる bug は Issue #4655 として報告し、fixture
  `array_concat_mixed_type_preservation_4655` を追加した。

### stack mixed eltype promotion (Issue #4018)

- `stack(arrays)` の mixed-eltype result allocation を `Matrix{Any}` fallback
  から、各 input vector の `eltype` を `promote_type` で畳み込んだ
  `_array_undef_from_dims(result_eltype, (m, n))` allocation へ移した。
- `stack((Int8[1, 2], Int16[3, 4]))` は `Matrix{Int16}`、
  `stack((Int8[1, 2], Float32[3, 4]))` は `Matrix{Float32}`、
  `stack((String["a", "b"], Any["c", "d"]))` は `Matrix{Any}` を返す。
- 作業中に mixed stack が `Matrix{Any}` へ広がる bug は Issue #4652、
  typed/boxed matrix equality の別 gap は Issue #4653 として報告し、fixture
  `array_stack_type_preservation` は matrix-level equality に依存せず
  type / shape / scalar values を固定する。

### cat mixed eltype promotion (Issue #4018)

- `base/array.jl` の `cat(A, B; dims)` mixed-eltype result allocation を
  `zeros(...)` fallback から `promote_type(eltype(A), eltype(B))` +
  `_array_undef_from_dims` に移し、upstream Julia と同じ promoted result
  eltype を使うようにした。
- `cat(Int8[1], Int16[2]; dims=1)` は `Vector{Int16}`、
  `cat(Int8[1], Float32[2]; dims=1)` は `Vector{Float32}`、
  `cat(String["a"], Any["b"]; dims=1)` は `Vector{Any}` を返す。
- 作業中に mixed numeric cat が `Vector{Float64}` へ widening し、
  `String` + `Any` が `"a"` → `Float64` conversion error になる bug は
  Issue #4651 として報告し、fixture
  `array_cat_string_type_preservation_4592` に regression coverage を追加した。

### Partition vector chunk view eltype preservation (Issues #4648/#4649)

- `partition(::Vector, n)` now follows upstream's vector-specialized behavior
  by yielding `SubArray` view chunks instead of freshly pushed `Vector{Any}`
  chunks.
- Generic `SubArray{T}` 1D view methods now cover narrow element types such as
  `Int8`, so `view(Int8[...], range)` reports `SubArray{Int8}` and remains
  collectable through typed allocation.
- Collecting `partition(Int8[1, 2, 3], 2)` now materializes
  `Vector{SubArray{Int8}}` locally, reducing another #4018 collect allocation
  fallback from `Vector{Any}` to a typed result.
- fixture `iteration_partition` covers the #4648 collect regression and the
  #4649 narrow-typed `view` regression.

### Rest explicit Array state parity (Issue #4647)

- Legacy native Array `iterate` state now follows upstream Julia's next-index
  convention: `iterate(Int8[1, 2, 3])` returns state `2`, and
  `iterate(a, 2)` returns the second element with next state `3`.
- `collect(Iterators.rest(Int8[1, 2, 3], 2))` now returns `Int8[2, 3]`
  instead of skipping one extra element and returning only `Int8[3]`.
- fixture `iteration_rest` covers the explicit array state regression reported
  as Issue #4647.

### Array{Any}/Array{Real} boxed numeric IndexStore preservation (Issue #4646)

- Direct `a[i] = v` on Pure Julia `Array` wrappers now keeps boxed numeric
  values intact until Julia `setindex!`/`convert(T, v)` runs, instead of
  widening the value through the scalar `F64` IndexStore fallback.
- The statement compiler no longer emits pre-`IndexStore` `ToF64` coercions for
  boxed numeric targets such as `ArrayOf(Any)`, `ArrayOf(Real)`, `MemoryOf(Any)`,
  Pure Julia wrapper structs, or dynamically typed targets.
- This fixes representative `Array{Any}` narrow integer storage and
  `Array{Real}` `Float32` storage while keeping concrete `Vector{Float64}`
  assignment conversion behavior unchanged.
- fixture `array_any_preserves_narrow_integer_4646` locks the bug reported as
  Issue #4646.

## 最新対応 (2026-05-26)

### generic similar(Array{T}, dims) tuple dispatch (Issues #4569/#4643)

- `similar(Array{T}, dims)` now follows the Pure Julia
  `similar(::Type{Array{T}}, dims::Tuple) where T` method from generic
  helpers, preserving element type and tuple shape for representative
  `Int64`, `Float64`, `Bool`, and `Complex{Float64}` values.
- Runtime `Array{T,length(dims)}` type construction now keeps integer value
  parameters instead of widening them to `Any`, and the resulting
  `Array{T,N}` type object is normalized through the Julia type parser. This
  fixes the rank assertion reported as Issue #4644.
- The runtime method search accepts concrete tuple runtime names
  (`Tuple{Int64}`, `Tuple{Int64, Int64}`, ...) for bare `::Tuple` parameters,
  which keeps storage-type `similar` calls on dispatch before the builtin
  fallback.
- The compiler no longer coerces `Any` dims in `similar` calls to `Int64`
  ahead of runtime dispatch, fixing unannotated tuple dims reported as
  Issue #4643.

### mixed String equality fallback (Issue #4642)

- Static `String`-vs-non-`String` `==` / `!=` now evaluates both operands,
  discards the values, and returns Julia's generic equality fallback result
  instead of trying to coerce the non-String operand.
- Dynamic `Any` equality fallback now returns `false` / `true` for no-method
  mixed equality pairs, covering `Any[1, "a"]` and `Any["a", 'a']` probes.
- fixture `operators_mixed_string_equality_4642` locks direct, side-effecting,
  and dynamic `Any` mixed String equality cases.

### prefix dotted not broadcast syntax (Issue #4019)

- The parser now accepts Julia prefix broadcast-not syntax such as `.!xs` and
  `.!Bool[true, false]`.
- This CST path lowers through the existing
  `materialize(Broadcasted(!, (...,)))` broadcast pipeline instead of failing
  at parse time.
- While validating this path, the missing callable `!` function-value fallback
  was reported as Issue #4640 and fixed by routing no-method function values
  through the existing intrinsic fallback.
- fixture `broadcast_unary_dot_not_4626` locks the bug reported as Issue #4626.

### Vector{Any} tuple element destructuring (Issue #4019)

- Typed array constructor lowering now preserves tuple expressions as single
  elements for type-like targets, so `Any[(name, values)]` creates a
  one-element `Vector{Any}` instead of flattening the tuple into two elements.
- This fixes `for (name, values) in cases` over `Vector{Any}` broadcast probe
  cases where each element is a tuple.
- fixture `broadcast_vector_any_tuple_destructuring_4627` locks the bug
  reported as Issue #4627.

### runtime DataType typed array constructor (Issue #4018)

- Runtime `DataType` indexing now follows Julia's typed array constructor
  semantics for representative vector literals: `T[1, 2]`,
  `getindex(T, 3, 4)`, and abstract `Real[...]` / `Number[...]` construct
  `Vector{T}` instead of trying to index the `DataType` value itself, while
  preserving concrete stored values such as `1.5::Float64` and
  `Float32(2.5)`.
- `IndexLoad` handles a `DataType` target by allocating a typed vector using
  the runtime element type and pushing converted integer literal values through
  the existing typed array storage path.
- fixture `array_runtime_datatype_typed_array_constructor_4606` locks the bugs
  reported as Issues #4586/#4606/#4641.

### typed Vector equality bridge (Issue #4639)

- `CallDynamicBinaryBoth` now handles the no-method `==` / `!=` fallback for
  legacy native Array carriers on a local Array-vs-Array equality bridge.
- This keeps the #3908 transition localized while making
  `Int16[1, 2] == Int16[1, 2]` match upstream Julia.
- fixture `array_typed_vector_equality_4639` locks the bug reported as
  Issue #4639, and the #4606 fixture now uses direct `Vector{Int16}` equality.

### typed matrix literal lowering (Issues #4575/#4629)

- Lowering now accepts typed matrix literals such as `Float32[1 2; 3 4]` and
  `Real[1 2.0; 3 4.0]`.
- The lowering expands the matrix literal to typed vector construction in
  column-major order followed by `reshape`, reusing the existing typed vector
  constructor and matrix storage paths.
- fixture `array_typed_matrix_literal_4575_4629` locks the direct matrix syntax,
  and `broadcast_materialization_type_preservation_4628` no longer needs the
  typed matrix literal workaround.

### floating-point Dict/Set keys (Issue #4018)

- Rust-backed `Dict` / `Set` keys now accept `Float16` / `Float32` / `Float64`
  scalar values instead of rejecting them as `InvalidDictKey`.
- `DictKey` numeric equality/hash handling now follows Julia `isequal` for
  representative integer/float-compatible keys: `Float32(1)`, `1.0`, and `1`
  match, while `-0.0` remains distinct from `0.0`.
- `Set(Float32[...])` now constructs successfully and supports membership with
  Julia's floating-point key semantics.
- fixture `collections_dict_set_float_keys_4638` locks the regression reported
  as Issue #4638.

### Dict Pair destructuring comprehension (Issue #4018)

- Array comprehensions now accept tuple destructuring bindings such as
  `[k for (k, v) in d]`.
- Tuple destructuring comprehensions use the existing Julia `iterate` protocol
  path instead of length/index iteration, so `Dict` Pair iteration works.
- fixture `collections_dict_pair_destructuring_comprehension_4632` locks the
  bug reported as Issue #4632.

### narrow integer identity / membership (Issue #4637)

- `===` now treats same-typed narrow signed/unsigned integer scalar values as
  identical by value while keeping different integer widths non-identical, as
  upstream Julia does.
- `isequal` and `hash` now canonicalize supported integer widths by numeric
  value, so representative `Int8` / `Int16` / `UInt8` equal values stay
  hash-compatible.
- `in(x, tuple)` uses Julia-style numeric equality for supported integer widths,
  fixing tuple membership such as `Int8(1) in (Int16(1), Int16(3))`.
- fixture `operators_narrow_integer_identity_membership_4637` locks the bug
  reported while validating Issue #4633.

### Dict narrow integer keys (Issue #4018)

- Rust-backed `Dict` keys now accept narrow signed/unsigned integer scalar
  values instead of rejecting them as `InvalidDictKey`.
- `Dict(Int8(1) => Int16(2), Int8(3) => Int16(4))` now preserves
  `Dict{Int8,Int16}` metadata, supports lookup/mutation with `Int8` keys, and
  keeps `collect(keys(d))` typed as `Vector{Int8}`.
- `DictKey` integer equality/hash handling now treats integer keys by numeric
  value across supported integer widths, matching Julia's `isequal`-style Dict
  key behavior for representative integer keys.
- fixture `collections_dict_narrow_integer_keys_4633` locks the regression
  reported as Issue #4633.
- While validating, a separate narrow integer `===` / tuple `in` bug was found
  and filed as Issue #4637; this slice avoids depending on that unrelated gap.

### Pair Type dispatch/reflection specificity (Issue #4018)

- `Type{Pair{K,V}}` method patterns now beat bare `Type{Pair}` methods for
  concrete Pair type objects such as `Pair{Int64,Int8}` in both static helper
  dispatch and reflection lookup.
- `which(f, Tuple{Type{Pair{Int64,Int8}}, Tuple{Int64}})` and tuple-value
  `which(f, (Type{Pair{Int64,Int8}}, Tuple{Int64}))` now use the same
  parametric `Type{...}` binding/scoring path as runtime dispatch.
- fixture `reflection_pair_type_parameter_dispatch_4636` locks the regression
  reported as Issue #4636.

### Pair typed undef allocation (Issue #4018)

- `Array{Pair{Int64,Int8}}(undef, n)` and
  `similar(Array{Pair{String,Int16}}, dims)` now preserve upstream
  `Vector{Pair{...}}` result metadata instead of widening to `Vector{Pair}` or
  `Vector{Any}`.
- Runtime callable dispatch now scores parametric `Type{Pair{K,V}}` patterns
  above bare `Type{Pair}` / generic `Type{T}` fallbacks, and `Memory{Pair{K,V}}`
  construction builds the element DataType from bound `K,V`.
- fixture `array_pair_typed_undef_allocation_4635` locks the public
  `Array{Pair{K,V}}(undef, n)` and `similar(Array{Pair{K,V}}, dims)` paths.
- The direct static helper/reflection mismatch filed as Issue #4636 is fixed
  in the follow-up section above.

### Pair-valued pairs collect typed allocation (Issue #4018)

- `collect(pairs(::Vector{Int8}))` / `collect(pairs(::Tuple{Int8,Int8}))`
  now preserve upstream `Vector{Pair{Int64, Int8}}` result metadata instead of
  widening to `Vector{Pair}` or entering the native collect fallback.
- `pairs(...)` call inference now keeps the `Pairs` carrier for array-like
  collections, and `collect(::Pairs)` routes through Pure Julia
  `_pairs_collect_dynamic` before the retained range/generator collect bridge.
- 作業中に見つけた `collect(pairs(::Vector{Int8}))` の Pair-valued collect
  widening bug は Issue #4634 として報告し、underlying
  `Array{Pair{K,V}}(undef, dims)` param drop は Issue #4635 として切り出した。
- fixture `collections_pairs_collect_type_preservation_4634` で direct
  `pairs(...)` と local binding 経由の result eltype / Pair values を固定した。

### generator expression collect typed allocation (Issue #4018)

- Comprehension-backed generator expressions now preserve representative narrow
  scalar source element types when materialized through `collect`.
- `collect(x for x in Int8[...])`, filtered `Int8` generators, same-typed
  `Int8` tuple generators, and `Float32` array generators allocate upstream
  matching `Vector{Int8}` / `Vector{Float32}` results instead of `Vector{Float64}`.
- 作業中に見つけた generator collect over `Int8` sources の `Vector{Float64}`
  widening bug は Issue #4631 として報告した。
- fixture `generator_collect_narrow_type_preservation_4631` で eager
  comprehension-backed generator collect の result eltype を固定した。

### mixed Vector set algebra allocation (Issue #4018)

- Generic `union` / `intersect` / `setdiff` / `symdiff` for mixed-element
  `Vector` inputs now allocate result storage with `promote_type(eltype(a), eltype(b))`
  via `_array_undef_from_dims` instead of seeding from `[]`.
- This preserves upstream promoted result eltypes for representative mixed
  narrow integer and `Float32` vector set operations while keeping same-eltype
  `similar(a, 0)` specializations intact.
- 作業中に見つけた mixed-element Vector set operations の `Vector{Any}` widening
  bug は Issue #4630 として報告した。
- fixture `collections_set_ops_mixed_type_preservation_4630` で promoted result
  eltype を固定した。

### broadcast materialization type preservation (Issue #4019)

- `Broadcasted` materialization の result type selection を拡張し、representative
  `Float32` / small signed integer / unsigned integer / `String` results が
  `Vector{Any}` や `Vector{Int64}` に広がらないようにした。
- same-eltype arithmetic broadcast は upstream Julia と同じ source element type
  を使って result allocation し、`Float32` division も `Float32` result を保持する。
- 作業中に見つけた `.!Bool[...]` parser gap は Issue #4626、`Vector{Any}` tuple
  destructuring gap は Issue #4627、broadcast materialization widening bug は
  Issue #4628 として報告した。
- fixture `broadcast_materialization_type_preservation_4628` で vector/scalar/matrix
  materialization result type を固定した。

### typed subtractive reductions (Issue #4019)

- `reduce(-, ::Vector{T})` / `foldl(-, ::Vector{T})` /
  `foldr(-, ::Vector{T})` と `mapfoldl(identity, -, ::Vector{T})` /
  `mapfoldr(identity, -, ::Vector{T})` / `mapreduce(identity, -, ::Vector{T})`
  に representative typed Vector specializations を追加し、left/right fold
  order と result type を upstream Julia に合わせた。
- small signed / unsigned integer input は source element type を保持し、
  unsigned `init` paths は upstream と同じ wraparound value を返す。
  `Float32` input は source float type を保持する。
- 作業中に見つけた typed `-` reductions の small integer widening bug は
  Issue #4625 として報告した。
- fixture `hof_reduction_minus_type_preservation_4625` で reduce/fold/mapfold の
  no-init / init typed subtractive result を固定した。

### typed multiplicative reductions (Issue #4019)

- `reduce(*, ::Vector{T})` / `foldl(*, ::Vector{T})` /
  `foldr(*, ::Vector{T})` と `mapfoldl(identity, *, ::Vector{T})` /
  `mapfoldr(identity, *, ::Vector{T})` / `mapreduce(identity, *, ::Vector{T})`
  に representative typed Vector specializations を追加し、empty input でも
  upstream Julia と同じ typed one identity を返すようにした。
- Bool input は `Bool` product result、small signed / unsigned integer input は
  source element type、`Float32` / `Float64` input は source float type を保持する。
- Scalar `Bool * Bool` now preserves `Bool` through the compiler binary path
  instead of widening to `Int64` (Issue #4624).
- 作業中に見つけた empty typed `*` reductions の例外と small integer widening
  bug は Issue #4623 として報告した。
- fixture `hof_reduction_mul_type_preservation_4623` で scalar Bool `*` と
  reduce/fold/mapfold の no-init / init typed product result を固定した。

### reduce/fold plus typed reduction (Issue #4019)

- `reduce(+, ::Vector{T})` / `foldl(+, ::Vector{T})` /
  `foldr(+, ::Vector{T})` に representative typed Vector specializations を追加し、
  empty input でも upstream Julia と同じ typed zero identity を返すようにした。
- `foldl` は既存通り `reduce` 経由で typed dispatch を共有し、`foldr` は
  right-fold public method に同じ typed reduction helper を追加した。
- 作業中に見つけた empty `reduce` / `foldl` / `foldr` 例外と small integer
  widening bug は Issue #4622 として報告した。
- fixture `hof_reduce_fold_plus_type_preservation_4622` で no-init / init typed
  result を固定した。

### mapfoldr identity-plus typed reduction (Issue #4019)

- `mapfoldr(identity, +, ::Vector{T})` に representative typed Vector
  specializations を追加し、empty input でも upstream Julia と同じ typed zero
  identity を返すようにした。
- `Int8` / `Int16` / `Int32` / unsigned integer / `Float32` / `Float64`
  result type を保持し、`Bool` input は upstream と同じく `Int64` count result
  を返す。`init::Bool` の empty case は `Bool` identity を保持する。
- 作業中に見つけた empty `mapfoldr(identity, +, A)` 例外と small integer
  widening bug は Issue #4620 として報告した。
- fixture `hof_mapfoldr_identity_plus_type_preservation_4620` で
  `mapfoldr` の no-init / init typed result を固定した。

### mapreduce identity-plus typed reduction (Issue #4019)

- `mapfoldl(identity, +, ::Vector{T})` / `mapreduce(identity, +, ::Vector{T})`
  に representative typed Vector specializations を追加し、empty input でも
  upstream Julia と同じ typed zero identity を返すようにした。
- `Int8` / `Int16` / `Int32` / unsigned integer / `Float32` / `Float64`
  result type を保持し、`Bool` input は upstream と同じく `Int64` count result
  を返す。`init::Bool` の empty case は `Bool` identity を保持する。
- 作業中に見つけた empty `mapreduce(identity, +, A)` 例外と small integer
  widening bug は Issue #4619 として報告した。
- fixture `hof_mapreduce_identity_plus_type_preservation_4619` で
  `mapreduce` / `mapfoldl` の no-init / init typed result を固定した。

### sum scalar typed reduction (Issue #4019)

- `sum(arr)` の scalar reduction に typed eltype branches を追加し、
  Bool / small signed integer vectors は `Int64`、unsigned integer vectors は
  `UInt64`、`Float32` vectors は `Float32` result を返すようにした。
- typed empty sums も upstream identity type (`Int64(0)`, `UInt64(0)`,
  `Float32(0)`) に合わせた。
- 作業中に見つけた scalar `sum` が empty Bool/Int8/UInt8 と non-empty UInt8 で
  upstream と異なる result type を返す bug は Issue #4618 として報告した。
- fixture `array_sum_scalar_type_preservation_4618` で non-empty / empty typed
  vector reductions の result type と値を固定した。

### sum! typed in-place reduction (Issue #4019)

- `sum!(r, A)` の in-place row/column reduction を `Float64(0.0)` accumulator から
  typed sum helpers に移し、Bool / small integer source の upstream-compatible
  reduction values を計算するようにした。
- Bool destination へ 2 以上の sum を保存しようとする場合は、sjulia 側で
  `true` に潰さず例外を投げるようにした。
- 作業中に見つけた `sum!` が Bool destination で multi-count sum を `true` に
  coerces する bug は Issue #4617 として報告した。
- fixture `array_sum_bang_type_preservation_4617` で destination identity /
  result type / eltype / values / Bool destination error を固定した。

### prod! typed in-place reduction (Issue #4019)

- `prod!(r, A)` の in-place row/column reduction を `Float64(1.0)` accumulator から
  shared typed product helpers に移し、`prod` / `prod(; dims)` と同じ typed
  product semantics を使うようにした。
- String matrix input は `Matrix{String}` / `Vector{String}` destination に
  product values を書き込み、Bool matrix input は `Matrix{Bool}` destination に
  logical product values を保持する。
- 作業中に見つけた `prod!` が String matrix で `operator(Float64, String)` に落ちる
  bug は Issue #4616 として報告した。
- fixture `array_prod_bang_type_preservation_4616` で destination identity /
  result type / eltype / values を固定した。

### prod scalar typed reduction (Issue #4019)

- `prod(arr)` の scalar reduction を unconditional `Int64(1)` accumulator から外し、
  representative typed vectors で upstream-compatible result type を返すようにした。
- small signed integer は `Int64`、small/large unsigned integer は `UInt64`、
  `Float32` は `Float32`、`Bool` は `Bool`、`String` は `String` result を返す。
- typed empty products も upstream identity type (`UInt64(1)`, `Float32(1)`,
  `true`, `""` など) に合わせた。
- 作業中に見つけた `prod(arr)` が `Int64` identity により `UInt8` / `Bool`
  result type を壊し、String product で `operator(Int64, String)` に落ちる bug は
  Issue #4615 として報告した。
- fixture `array_prod_scalar_type_preservation_4615` を追加し、
  `array_prod_dims_type_preservation_4614` に Bool dims coverage を追加した。

### prod dims typed allocation (Issue #4019)

- `prod(A; dims=1/2)` の result allocation を `ones(...)` から
  first reduced value の runtime type に基づく typed allocation へ移した。
- small signed integer matrix reductions は upstream `mul_prod` と同じく
  `Matrix{Int64}`、small unsigned reductions は `Matrix{UInt64}`、String
  reductions は `Matrix{String}` result を返す。
- 作業中に見つけた `prod(; dims)` が `Matrix{Float64}` を確保し、String matrix で
  `operator(Float64, String)` に落ちる bug は Issue #4614 として報告した。
- fixture `array_prod_dims_type_preservation_4614` で dims=1/2 の result type /
  eltype / scalar value type / shape / values を固定した。

### vararg map typed allocation (Issue #4019)

- `map(f, A::Array, B::Array, C::Array, As::Array...)` の Pure Julia fallback を
  追加し、3+ source Array map を upstream `map(f, it, iters...)` に近い
  dispatch-first path へ寄せた。
- generic callable result は最初の mapped value の runtime type で確保し、
  representative `String` output や shortest-input semantics を保持する。
- `map(+, ...)` の same-eltype typed Vector vararg paths は `similar(A, n)` または
  Bool 用 `Vector{Int64}` allocation を使い、upstream Julia と同じ result type を返す。
- 作業中に見つけた `LoadSlotI64` failure は Issue #4611、n-ary small integer `+`
  gap は Issue #4612、Int8 overflow saturation は Issue #4613 として報告した。
- fixture `hof_map_vararg_type_preservation_4611` で 3-source / 4-source /
  shortest-input / empty result と Int8 overflow wrapping parity を固定した。

### binary map typed allocation (Issue #4019)

- `map(f, A::Array, B::Array)` の Pure Julia fallback を `[]` /
  `Vector{Any}` allocation から、最初の mapped value の runtime type に基づく
  typed result allocation へ移した。
- `map(+, A, B)` / `map(*, A, B)` の representative typed Vector paths では
  small integer / unsigned integer / Float32 / Float64 / Bool の result type を
  upstream Julia に合わせる singleton-function specializations を追加した。
- 作業中に見つけた binary `map` が typed results を `Vector{Any}` に広げる bug は
  Issue #4610 として報告した。
- fixture `hof_map_binary_type_preservation_4610` で operator paths と generic
  String callable path の result type / eltype / scalar value type / 値を固定した。

### accumulate operator typed allocation (Issue #4018)

- `accumulate(+, A)` / `accumulate(*, A)` と generic
  `accumulate(f, A::Array)` の representative typed Vector paths を
  `[]` / `Vector{Any}` fallback から typed result allocation に移し、small
  integer / unsigned integer / Float32 / Float64 / Bool / String の result
  element type を upstream Julia に合わせた。
- Bool は upstream と同じく `accumulate(+, Bool[...])` を `Vector{Int64}`、
  `accumulate(*, Bool[...])` を `Vector{Bool}` として扱う。
- 作業中に見つけた `accumulate` typed input が `Vector{Any}` に広がる bug は
  Issue #4608 として報告した。
- generic callable で accumulator が `Float32` などに promote される path は
  最初の演算結果から runtime result eltype を決めるようにし、追加で見つけた
  changing accumulator type gap は Issue #4645 として報告した。`=>` body を持つ
  arrow function は parser precedence を修正し、`Vector{Any}` result に到達する。
- single-element / empty `Int8` vectors now use a lightweight
  `_accumulate_promote_op` approximation based on representative sample values,
  so `/`, `Float32`-promoting lambdas, and changing-shape `=>` lambdas allocate
  `Vector{Float64}`, `Vector{Float32}`, and `Vector{Any}` respectively, matching
  upstream Julia for the covered cases.
- fixture `array_accumulate_operator_type_preservation_4608` で operator paths と
  generic callable paths の result type / eltype / scalar value type / 値を固定した。

### hcat small integer typed allocation (Issue #4018)

- `hcat` の homogeneous vector allocation に `Int16` / `Int32` /
  `UInt8` / `UInt16` / `UInt32` / `UInt64` typed flat-buffer branches を
  追加し、`reshape` 後の result を `Matrix{T}` のまま保持するようにした。
- mixed vector input も Issue #4655 follow-up で `promote_type` に基づく
  typed allocation へ移行済み。
- 作業中に見つけた runtime `T[1,2]` constructor bug は Issue #4606、
  `hcat` small integer widening bug は Issue #4607 として報告した。
- fixture `array_hcat_small_integer_type_preservation_4607` で 2-arg と
  3-arg homogeneous `hcat` の result type / eltype / scalar value type / 値を
  固定した。

### adjoint Complex typed allocation (Issue #4018)

- `adjoint(::Array)` の materialized result allocation に
  `Complex{Float64}` typed branch を追加し、Complex vector/matrix input で
  result element type を保持しながら conjugate transpose するようにした。
- 作業中に見つけた Complex input が `StructRef` を dim として coercion して
  `expected I64` runtime error になる bug は Issue #4604 として報告した。
- fixture `array_adjoint_complex_type_preservation_4604` で vector/matrix input の
  `eltype` / shape / scalar value type / conjugated values を固定した。

### Complex typed array literal allocation (Issue #4018)

- Runtime `DataType` typed array construction now preserves raw element values
  for `ComplexF64[...]` and `Complex{T}[...]` instead of coercing them through
  integer index/dimension handling.
- `ComplexF64` / `ComplexF32` aliases now resolve to the corresponding
  `Complex{Float64}` / `Complex{Float32}` DataType values for type equality and
  typed allocation.
- The bug was reported as Issue #4605 and locked by fixture
  `array_complex_typed_array_literal_4605`.

### stack homogeneous typed allocation (Issue #4018)

- `stack(arrays)` で homogeneous input の result allocation を
  `similar(first_arr, m, n)` に移し、`Matrix{Any}` fallback ではなく input eltype を
  保持するようにした。
- mixed-eltype input も Issue #4652 follow-up で `promote_type` に基づく
  typed allocation へ移行済み。
- 作業中に見つけた `stack([Float32[...]...])` / `stack([Int8[...]...])` が
  `Matrix{Any}` を返す bug は Issue #4603 として報告した。
- fixture `array_stack_type_preservation` に `Float32` / `Int8` / `Bool` /
  `String` / `Float64` の container type assertions を追加した。

### adjoint small integer typed allocation (Issue #4018)

- `adjoint(::Array)` の materialized result allocation に small signed/unsigned
  integer typed branches を追加し、`Int8` / `UInt8` などの input で result
  element type を保持するようにした。
- 作業中に見つけた `adjoint(::Vector{Int8/UInt8})` が `Matrix{Float64}` を
  返す bug は Issue #4602 として報告した。
- fixture `array_adjoint_small_integer_type_preservation_4602` で vector/matrix
  input の `eltype` / shape / scalar value type / 値を固定した。

### adjoint Bool typed allocation (Issue #4018)

- `adjoint(::Array)` の materialized result allocation に `Bool` typed branch を
  追加し、`Vector{Bool}` / `Matrix{Bool}` input で result element type を
  `Bool` のまま保持するようにした。
- 作業中に見つけた `adjoint(::Vector/Matrix{Bool})` が `Matrix{Float64}` を
  返す bug は Issue #4601 として報告した。
- fixture `array_adjoint_bool_type_preservation_4601` で vector/matrix input の
  `eltype` / shape / scalar value type / 値を固定した。

### diff typed allocation (Issue #4018)

- `diff(arr)` の result allocation を `zeros(n - 1)` から `similar(arr, n - 1)`
  に移し、`Int8` / `Float32` input で upstream Julia と同じ result eltype を
  保持するようにした。
- 作業中に見つけた `diff(::Vector{Int8/Float32})` が `Vector{Float64}` に広がる
  bug は Issue #4600 として報告した。
- fixture `reduce_extrema_diff` に non-Float64 `diff` result type / eltype /
  scalar value type / 値の regression を追加した。

### empty array typed allocation (Issue #4018)

- `empty(::Array{T})` を `zeros(0)` fallback から `_array_undef_from_dims(T, (0,))`
  に移し、source array の element type を保持するようにした。
- `empty(arr, ::Type{S})` は requested element type `S` の 0-length array を
  返すようにした。
- 作業中に見つけた `empty(::Array)` / `empty(arr, T)` が常に `Vector{Float64}` を
  返す bug は Issue #4599 として報告した。
- fixture `array_empty_array_type_preservation_4599` で `Float32` / `Int8` /
  requested `Int16` / `Any` result の type / eltype / length を固定した。

### permutedims explicit Float32 typed allocation (Issue #4018)

- `permutedims(A, perm)` の 2D identity copy / 3D / 4D result allocation を
  `zeros(...)` から `similar(A, ...)` に移し、`Float32` input で result eltype を
  `Float32` のまま保持するようにした。
- 作業中に見つけた explicit permutation が `Float32` arrays を
  `Float64` result に広げる bug は Issue #4598 として報告した。
- fixture `array_permutedims_explicit_float32_type_preservation_4598` で
  2D identity / 3D / 4D explicit permutation の type / eltype / shape / 値を固定した。

### adjoint Float32 typed allocation (Issue #4018)

- `adjoint(::Array)` の materialized result allocation に `Float32` typed branch
  を追加し、`Vector{Float32}` / `Matrix{Float32}` input で result element type を
  `Float32` のまま保持するようにした。
- 作業中に見つけた `adjoint(::Vector/Matrix{Float32})` が `Matrix{Float64}` を
  返す bug は Issue #4597 として報告した。
- fixture `array_adjoint_float32_type_preservation_4597` で vector/matrix input の
  `eltype` / shape / scalar value type / 値を固定した。

### reduction dims typed allocation (Issue #4018)

- `minimum(A; dims=1/2)` / `maximum(A; dims=1/2)` の result allocation を
  `zeros(...)` から `similar(A, ...)` に寄せ、`Matrix{String}` result の
  element type を保持できるようにした。
- `extrema(A; dims=1/2)` は最初の `(min, max)` tuple から result type を取り、
  upstream Julia と同じ `Matrix{Tuple{T,T}}` shape を返すようにした。
- `sum(A::Matrix{Bool}; dims=1/2)` は upstream Julia と同じ `Matrix{Int64}`
  result を返すよう、Bool branch だけ `_array_undef_from_dims(Int64, ...)` と
  integer accumulator を使う。
- 作業中に String reduction dims の conversion error を Issue #4595、
  Bool sum dims の result type mismatch を Issue #4596 として報告した。
- fixture `array_reduce_dims_string_type_preservation_4595` と
  `array_sum_dims_bool_type_preservation_4596` で型・shape・値を固定した。

### sortslices String typed allocation (Issue #4018)

- `base/array.jl` の `sortslices(A; dims)` result allocation を
  `zeros(m, n)` から `similar(A, m, n)` に寄せた。
- 作業中に `sortslices(::Matrix{String}; dims=1/2)` が `Matrix{Float64}` を
  確保して conversion error になる既存 bug を Issue #4594 として報告した。
- fixture `array_sortslices_string_type_preservation_4594` を追加し、
  row sort / column sort の `Matrix{String}` result type と値を固定した。

### mapslices typed slice/result allocation (Issue #4018)

- `base/array.jl` の `mapslices` で、row/column temporary slice を
  `zeros(...)` ではなく `similar(A, len)` で確保するようにした。
- result は最初の `f(slice)` の runtime type を使い、
  `_array_undef_from_dims(typeof(first_value), shape)` で上流 Julia と同じ
  `dims=1 => 1×n`、`dims=2 => m×1` の matrix shape に寄せた。
- 作業中に `mapslices(length, Matrix{String}; dims=...)` が temp slice の
  `Vector{Float64}` allocation で conversion error になる既存 bug を
  Issue #4593 として報告し、fixture
  `array_mapslices_string_type_preservation_4593` で `Matrix{Int64}` result を
  固定した。

### cat String typed allocation (Issue #4018)

- `base/array.jl` の `cat(A, B; dims)` で、同一 `eltype(A) == eltype(B)`
  の result allocation を untyped `zeros(...)` から `_cat_result_like`
  経由の `similar(A, ...)` に寄せた。
- mixed eltype input も Issue #4651 follow-up で `promote_type(eltype(A),
  eltype(B))` に基づく typed allocation へ移行済み。
- 作業中に `cat(["a"], ["b"]; dims=1)` や `cat(Matrix{String}, Matrix{String})`
  が `Vector{Float64}` / `Matrix{Float64}` を確保して conversion error になる
  既存 bug を Issue #4592 として報告し、fixture
  `array_cat_string_type_preservation_4592` で `Vector{String}` /
  `Matrix{String}` result を固定した。

### selectdim/dropdims String fallback typed allocation (Issue #4018)

- `subarray.jl` の `selectdim` / `dropdims` fallback path で、
  `MatrixView` specialization のない element type を copy materialize する際に
  `zeros(n)` を使わず `similar(A, n)` で result を確保するようにした。
- これにより `Matrix{String}` の `selectdim` / `dropdims` が
  `Vector{Float64}` allocation に落ちて `"a"` → `Float64` conversion error
  になる境界を解消した。
- 作業中にこの既存 bug を Issue #4591 として報告し、fixture
  `views_selectdim_dropdims_string_fallback_4591` で `eltype` と値を固定した。

### cumsum/cumprod typed allocation (Issue #4018)

- `base/accumulate.jl` の `cumsum` / `cumprod` を、常に `zeros(n)` から
  `Vector{Float64}` を確保する実装から、上流 Julia と同じ result element
  type を選ぶ concrete Vector methods に寄せた。
- signed small integer input は `Vector{Int64}`、unsigned integer input は
  `Vector{UInt64}`、`Float32` / `Float64` input は `similar(arr, length(arr))`
  で同型 result を確保する。`Bool` は上流に合わせ、`cumsum(Bool[])` 系を
  `Vector{Int64}`、`cumprod(Bool[])` 系を `Vector{Bool}` として扱う。
- 作業中に、sjulia の `cumsum(Int64[...])` / `cumsum(Float32[...])` /
  `cumprod(...)` が `Vector{Float64}` に落ちる allocation bug を Issue #4590
  として報告し、この slice で fixture 化した。

### unique and Vector set algebra similar fallback (Issue #4018)

- `base/set.jl` の `unique(::Vector{Int8/Int16/Int32/UInt8/UInt16/UInt32/UInt64/Float32/Symbol/Any})`
  と `unique(f, ::Vector{...})` の result allocation を `similar(arr, 0)` に寄せた。
  既存の `Int64` / `Float64` / `Bool` / `String` / `Char` specializations は
  互換性のため残しつつ、narrow integer や `Symbol` が generic `[]`
  fallback で `Vector{Any}` に落ちる境界を縮小した。
- `union` / `intersect` / `setdiff` / `symdiff` の same-element Vector
  methods も concrete element type ごとに `similar(a, 0)` allocation へ寄せた。
  `Int8` / `Int16` / `Float32` / `Symbol` / `Any` の代表ケースは fixture で
  result `typeof` / `eltype` まで固定済み。
- 未束縛 `Vector` signature は current dispatch で `Any` fallback と曖昧になるため
  使わず、concrete element-type methods に限定した。
- 作業中に `Real[1, 1.0]` / `Number[1, 1.0]` の typed array literal が
  `DataType` indexing error になる gap を Issue #4586 として切り出し、
  runtime DataType typed-array constructor fixture に固定してローカル確認済み。
  heterogeneous `unique(Any[1, "a", 1])` の mixed `isequal` error は
  Issue #4587 として切り出し、`isequal(::String, ::Any)` /
  `isequal(::Any, ::String)` fallback を Pure Julia 側に追加してローカル修正済み。
  raw mixed `==` / `!=` fallback の broader parity gap は Issue #4642 として
  報告し、ローカル修正済み。
- 追加の related regression として、Pure Julia Array wrapper 化された
  `zeros(Complex{Float64}, 2)` に対する `in` が `StructRef` receiver を
  拒否する問題を Issue #4588 として切り出し、builtin `in` の Array wrapper
  branch で `_mem` の logical elements を走査するようにした。
- `Vector{Any}` result の equality assertion が
  `operator(Vector{Any}, Vector{Any})` MethodError に落ちる別問題は
  Issue #4589 として切り出し、現在の Array equality bridge で
  `Any[1,2] == Any[1,2]` / `union(Any[1,2], Any[2,3]) == Any[1,2,3]`
  までローカル確認済み。

### test-side Value::Array comment allowlist cleanup (Issue #3908)

- `subset_julia_vm/tests/test_mandelbrot_grid_comparison.rs` はすでに
  `legacy_array_value_ref` helper 経由で result を読むようになっていたが、
  説明コメント内に literal `Value::Array` token が 1 件残っていた。
- コメントを legacy native-array variant への説明に言い換え、
  `scripts/check_value_array_allowlist.sh` の test-side 例外を削除した。
  これで `subset_julia_vm/tests/` 配下の literal `Value::Array` は 0 件になり、
  新規追加は allowlist audit で失敗する。

### zeros/ones/fill tuple-dims similar(Array) allocation (Issue #4018)

- `base/array.jl` の `fill(value, dims...)` と `zeros` / `ones` 共通の
  `_array_undef_from_dims` を、直接 `Array{T}(undef, ...)` に戻す形から
  concrete element type では Pure Julia `similar(Array{T}, dims)` wrapper
  dispatch に寄せた。
- 上流 `julia/base/array.jl` / `baseext.jl` と同じく tuple dimensions を
  public Array allocation API として扱い、`zeros(Int64, (2, 3))` /
  `ones(Int64, (2, 3))` / `zeros(Complex{Float64}, (2, 2))` の sjulia
  dispatch gapを concrete tuple-dims methods で補完。
- fixture は 4D tuple-dims `fill` / `zeros` と
  `similar(Array{Real}, (2, 2))` も検証し、high-rank shape と
  abstract numeric element type の storage-type allocation を上流 Julia と
  比較可能にした。
- runtime dispatch resolver が `Type{Array{T}}` の内側 typevar を
  concrete DataType 値に束縛できるようになったため、generic `where T`
  helper からの `similar(Array{T}, dims)` も constructor fallback なしで通る
  (Issue #4569)。
- `adjoint(::LinRange)` / `adjoint(::StepRangeLen)` の row-vector 確保も
  `Array{T}(undef, 1, n)` 直呼びから `_array_undef_from_dims(T, (1, n))`
  に寄せ、concrete `T` では同じ `similar(Array{T}, dims)` wrapper
  dispatch を使う。
- `iterators.jl` の shaped collect materialization も、`Int64` /
  `Float64` / `Float32` / `Bool` / `String` / `Char` /
  `Complex{Float64}` / `Real` / `Any` の concrete/dedicated element type では
  `_array_undef_from_dims` 経由に寄せ、`collect_similar` の
  2D generator result allocation が同じ wrapper dispatch を通る。
  `Type{Any}` exact method が generic `Type{T}` と曖昧にならないよう
  MethodTable specificity も修正した (Issue #4574)。
- generic `_array_for_inner_shape(::Type{T}, dims)` も direct constructor
  fallback を削除し、`_array_undef_from_dims(T, dims)` へ統一した。
  併せて `Type{Any}` の非 exact singleton match を generic `Type{T}` より
  弱くし、`Base._array_undef_from_dims(Symbol, (2, 2))` が
  `Matrix{Symbol}` を返すようにした (Issue #4577)。
- compiler の `Array{T}(undef, dims...)` / `Array{T}(undef, tuple_dims)`
  lowering も direct `AllocUndef*` instruction ではなく
  `_array_undef_from_dims(T, dims_tuple)` call に寄せた。runtime `T` は
  callable dispatch で `DataType` ではなく `Type{T}` singleton として
  method selection されるため、generic helper からの
  `Array{T}(undef, (2,))` も wrapper dispatch に到達する (Issue #4580)。
- `print` / `println` の Any-typed argument は builtin I/O compiler path に
  逃がし、static singleton fallback が `Nothing` coercion を要求する
  regression を避ける。Any → Nothing coercion には runtime value を保持する
  no-op を追加し、selected runtime path 側で妥当性を判断させる
  (Issue #4580)。
- `ArrayPop` が Pure Julia Array wrapper (`StructRef`) を受けた場合、
  1D wrapper の `_mem` / `_size` から末尾要素を取り出して wrapper を
  更新する path を追加した。これにより `resize!` shrink と `copy!` の
  vector resize が `ArrayPop: expected Array or Set, got "StructRef"` に
  落ちる regression を修正した (Issue #4570)。
- 3D Array wrapper の `getindex(A, 1, :, :)` / `getindex(A, :, 2, :)` /
  `getindex(A, :, :, 1)` / `getindex(A, :, :, :)` を Pure Julia methods として
  追加し、range/colon slice が native range-index MethodError に落ちる
  regression を修正した (Issue #4571)。
- runtime dispatch の `Array{T}` pattern を次元未束縛 Array として扱い、
  `Vector{T}` / `Matrix{T}` / `Array{T,N}` 実引数を invariant element match
  で受けられるようにした。`collect(x::Any)` から
  `collect(::Array{Int64})` user method が選ばれ、`Array{Real}` は
  `Vector{Float64}` に誤 dispatch しない (Issue #4581)。
- parser が matrix row 内の `[:x :y]` を `(:x):y` range と誤読していた
  境界を修正し、`Matrix{Symbol}` literal と
  `collect_similar([:a], Generator(identity, Matrix{Symbol}))` を
  upstream と同じ shape/value で materialize できるようにした
  (Issue #4576)。
- #4579 の Array wrapper collect fallback 修正により、3D Array source の
  `collect_similar` も通るようになったため、Issue #4573 の再現を
  `generator_trait_collect_similar_4052` に追加した。
- fixture `array_zeros_ones_fill_tuple_dims_4018` を追加し、型・shape・値を
  upstream Julia と比較可能にした。`Array{Int64}(undef, 2, 3)` /
  `Array{Float64}(undef, (2,))` / generic `Array{T}(undef, (2,))` も同じ
  fixture で検証する。
- fixture `array_range_adjoint_similar_allocation_4018` を追加し、
  `StepRangeLen` の adjoint row shape と要素を検証する。
- fixture `generator_trait_collect_similar_4052` を拡張し、Bool / Char /
  Symbol / String / Float32 / Complex{Float64} / 3D Array source の shaped
  generator collect result も検証する。Float32 payload は `===` まで
  検証する。

### Float16/Float32/Bool identity parity (Issues #4582, #4583, #4584)

- `BuiltinId::Egal` に Float16 / Float32 の bit identity arm と Bool の
  value identity arm を追加し、`Float32(NaN) === Float32(NaN)` /
  `Float16(NaN) === Float16(NaN)` / `true === true` を upstream Julia と
  同じ結果にした。
- `isequal` の Float16 / Float32 arm と mixed narrow-float comparisons も
  Float64 と同じ NaN-aware signed-zero semantics に寄せ、`-0.0` と `0.0`
  の distinction を保存する。
- fixture `types_float_identity_4582` を追加し、narrow float の
  `===` / `isequal` と Bool identity を regression coverage にした。

### Small integer Array allocation and sizeof parity (Issues #4018, #4585)

- `_array_undef_from_dims(::Type{Int8/Int16/Int32/UInt8/UInt16/UInt32/UInt64}, dims)`
  を追加し、`Vector{Int8}(undef, n)` などの public Array allocation が
  `Vector{Real}` に widen せず `similar(Array{T}, dims)` wrapper dispatch へ
  進むようにした。
- `sizeof(::Array)` の VM fallback は legacy native Array だけでなく Pure
  Julia `Array{T}` wrapper の `_mem` / `_size` も読むようにし、
  Memory-backed wrapper array でも payload byte size を返す。
- `types_sizeof_basic` に small signed/unsigned integer vector の
  `typeof` / `eltype` / `sizeof` regression を追加した。

  consolidation floor に到達。

  いたが、`sub_array_parent_array_ref` の `Some(Value::Array(arr))` 直接
  match と、Generator integer-indexing fallback における
  `g.iter.as_ref()` への `Value::Array(arr) => { ... }` 直接 match という
  2 か所が helper を経由せずに残っていた。
- `sub_array_parent_array_ref` を first 値 clone → `array_ref_from_value`
  経由に変更 (Array 場合は Rc bump で安価)。Err 経路は同一の
  `VmError::InternalError("SubArray parent must be an Array")` を返す。
- Generator iter fallback は `array_ref_from_value((*g.iter).clone())` で
  routing し、`Ok(arr)` で従来通り `ArrayValue::get_linear()` 経由の
  logical read、`Err(Value::Range(_))` / `Err(Value::Tuple(_))` /
  `Err(other)` で残りの分岐 (Range/Tuple/internal error) を維持する形に
  書き換えた。Generator integer indexing は稀な fallback path なので
  iter 値の clone は許容できる。
- `scripts/check_value_array_allowlist.sh` の `vm/exec/array_index.rs`
  ceiling を 4 → 2 に引き下げ。残る 2 件は `array_value` 構築 helper と
  `array_ref_from_value` destructure helper の本体のみ。挙動・出力変化
  なし。

  `bash scripts/check_value_array_allowlist.sh` /
  `bash scripts/check_docs_vm_refs.sh` /
  `cargo check -p subset_julia_vm` /
  `cargo build --release --bin sjulia --features repl` /
  `timeout 1500 cargo nextest run --release --test fixture_tests array:: iteration:: iterators:: generator::` (11 passed)

### compile/inference_trace audit cleanup (Issue #3908)

- `compile/inference_trace.rs` の `serialize_env` 内で `use serde_json::{json, Value};`
  経由のローカル別名により `Value::Array(entries)` が出現していた。これは
  `serde_json::Value::Array` であり、ランタイムの `crate::vm::value::Value::Array`
  とは別物。`scripts/check_value_array_allowlist.sh` の grep は両者を区別でき
  ないため false positive となっていた。
- ローカル `use serde_json::Value;` を削除し、`serde_json::Value::Null` は
  完全修飾、配列構築は `Vec<serde_json::Value>::into()` 経由に書き換えて
  literal `Value::Array` テキストを 1 → 0 に削減。`scripts/check_value_array_allowlist.sh`
  からは当該エントリを削除。JSON 出力は完全に同一 (Vec<serde_json::Value> の
  `Into<serde_json::Value>` は `Value::Array(self)` を返す)。挙動・テスト影響なし。

### vm/exec/array_index destructure helpers (round 3) (Issue #3908)

- `vm/exec/array_index.rs` の `IndexLoad` (target dispatch)、`IndexStore`
  (`is_complex_val` ブランチ)、`IndexStore` (scalar f64/i64 ブランチ) の
  3 つの直接 `match arr_val { Value::Array(arr) => ..., other arms ..., _ =>
  ... }` パターンを、既存の file-local helper
  `array_ref_from_value(Value) -> Result<ArrayRef, Value>` 経由に集約。
  - `IndexLoad`: `match target { Value::Str(_) | Value::Array(_) |
    Value::Tuple(_) | ... | other => ... }` を `match array_ref_from_value(target)
    { Ok(arr) => { arr.borrow().get(&indices) ... }, Err(target) => match
    target { Value::Str(_) | Value::Tuple(_) | ... | other => ... } }` に
    書き換え。String/Tuple/NamedTuple/Range/Generator/Struct/StructRef/Dict/
    Ref/Memory/other の各既存 arm はそのまま `Err(target)` 内で分岐する。

    Complex の interleaved / boxed 各分岐、`Value::Memory` の f64/i64 経路、
    `target @ Value::Struct(_) | target @ Value::StructRef(_)` の
    `setindex!` 多重ディスパッチ、INTERNAL error arm はすべて従来通り。
  - `IndexStore` scalar f64/i64: SubArray の `parent` 書き戻し (StructRef /
    inline Struct) と Dict / Memory / other は `Err(arr_val) => match arr_val
    { ... }` 経由で `Value::Struct(ref s)` arm が `arr_val` を再利用できる
    ようリバインドして保持。

  経由の読み書きと `array_value(arr)` re-push、SubArray の bool/f64/i64
  書き戻し、Dict 整数キーの assign、Memory の `set` フォールバック、
  Complex IndexStore の interleaved / boxed 経路はすべて維持。

### typed/symbol comprehensions and struct/vector equality regressions (Issues #4462, #4463, #4446)

- Parser/lowering now accepts Julia's typed array comprehension form
  `T[expr for var in iter]` by parsing it as a typed expression over a
  comprehension and lowering the body through the requested constructor.
- Symbol-valued array comprehensions preserve `Vector{Symbol}` element type
  instead of entering numeric `DynamicToF64` conversion paths.
- Struct fields that hold `collect(1:n)` vectors can participate in `==` even
  when the field expression is statically `Any`; array-like equality routes to
  the VM `isequal` bridge instead of selecting an incompatible static method.

### Plots include cache and function-y series data (Issue #4452)

- Bundled `Plots` now supports `plot(x, f::Function)`, `plot!(x, f::Function)`,
  `scatter(x, f::Function)`, and `scatter!(x, f::Function)` by mapping `f`
  across `x`, matching upstream Plots' `_compute_y(x, y::Function, z)` behavior.
- Package loader cache keys now include literal `include("...")` source content
  recursively, so edits to bundled files such as `Plots/src/api.jl` invalidate
  stale cached modules instead of reusing old method tables.

  String を Array of indices で部分文字列化する arm、そして slicing
  ターゲット unwrap) を集約。前 3 箇所は wildcard fallback を持つ
  `match` の下にガード付き `_ if legacy_array_value_ref(...).is_some() => { ... }`
  arm として書き換え、target unwrap は `if let Some(arr_ref) =
  legacy_array_value_ref(&target) { arr_ref.clone() } else { ... }` 形にして
  `getindex` ディスパッチ fallback への流れを保ったまま native carrier の
  直接マッチを除去。
- 1D / 2D / 一般 N-D の slice result re-push 3 箇所を新規
  `array_value(ArrayValue) -> Value` helper 経由に集約し、
  `Value::Array(new_array_ref(result_arr))` の重複を排除。
- `scripts/check_value_array_allowlist.sh` の
  `subset_julia_vm_vm/src/vm/exec/array_index_slice.rs` 上限を 7 から 2 に
  縮小 (削減数 5)。残る 2 件は `legacy_array_value_ref` 本体の
  `Value::Array(a) => Some(a)` と `array_value` 本体の
  `Value::Array(new_array_ref(arr))` のみ。
- 既存の array indexing / slicing / string slicing fixture が
  リファクタ後も従来通り通過することを確認 (Vector slice, Matrix
  multi-dim slice, String range slice / Array-of-indices slice 含む)。

### array_index logical-load ArrayValue helper routing (Issue #3908)

  the IndexStore variants behind a single `array_value(ArrayRef) -> Value`
  constructor helper so the legacy native-array enum constructor lives in one
  place in `vm/exec/array_index.rs`.

  from 22 to 16 in `scripts/check_value_array_allowlist.sh`.
- Added `array::logical_index_load_helper_3908` fixture covering logical Bool
  selection over Int64 and Float64 vectors and integer-index reorder through
  the refactored helper. Verified against upstream Julia 1.12 and
  `target/release/sjulia`.

### vm/mod Array equality bridge helpers (Issue #3908 / Issue #4189)

- Centralized the transitional native array carrier unwrap in
  `legacy_array_value_ref`, with `is_legacy_array_value`,
  `is_array_wrapper_param_type`, and `legacy_array_value_ptr_eq` reusing it so
  callers no longer destructure `Value::Array` directly.
- Routed the `value_matches_param` dispatch guard, the production
  `compare_struct_field_values_egal` arm, and the `cfg(test)`
  `compare_values_equal` Array/Memory arms through the new helpers, preserving
  Pure Julia Array wrapper vs native carrier dispatch and pointer-egal
  semantics.

  from 12 to 7 in `scripts/check_value_array_allowlist.sh` to lock in the
  reduction.

### binary_both Memory<->Array boundary and matmul guard cleanup (Issue #3908)

- `memory_array_values_equal` now reads memory cells through `MemoryValue::get`
  (1-indexed public boundary) instead of touching `MemoryValue::data` directly,
  matching the rest of the Array/Memory migration.
- Extracted an `is_legacy_array_value` predicate and folded four `Value::Array`
  pattern-only guards in the matmul / scalar-array fallback paths into the
  predicate, so the file's `Value::Array` ceiling drops from 19 to 13.
- Added `array::memory_array_equality_boundary_3908` fixture covering the
  bridge for matching, differing, and length-mismatched cases.
- Tightened `scripts/check_array_public_data_access.sh` so the new boundary
  cannot regress to raw `memory.data.get_value` access.

### Dynamic op Array storage helper (Issue #3908)

- Added `ArrayValue::supports_inline_dynamic_storage()` so retained dynamic
  arithmetic dispatch no longer matches raw `ArrayData::StructRefs` /
  `ArrayData::Any` tags directly.
- Routed `vm/dynamic_ops/dispatch.rs` Array inline-op classification through
  that helper for Array/Array and Array/scalar cases.
- Extended the public Array data-access audit so direct raw storage tag checks
  cannot return to `dynamic_ops/dispatch.rs`.

### Plots default SVG axes (Issue #4437)

- Added default x/y axis line rendering to generated SVG plot artifacts.
- Axes are emitted as SVG `<line>` elements with stable `data-role` markers so
  they do not interfere with existing line-series `<path>` and scatter
  `<circle>` checks.
- Added REPL artifact coverage for default axis generation.

### Expr Array splat logical read (Issue #3908)

- Routed `Expr` constructor Array splat expansion through
  `ArrayValue::get_linear()` instead of raw `borrowed.data.get_value(...)` in
  `vm/builtins_macro/mod.rs`.
- Preserved the call lowering splat mask for `Expr(...)` by converting splatted
  arguments into the existing `SplatInterpolation` marker before compiling
  `ExprNewWithSplat` (Issue #4435).
- Added a metaprogramming fixture for `Expr(:call, args...)` with an Array
  splat and extended the public Array data-access audit to guard this path.

### Deterministic precompile-base serialization (Issue #4438)

- `sjulia --precompile-base` used to write different bytes on every
  invocation because `bincode` serialized `HashMap`/`HashSet` values in
  per-process random order. Combined with `target/base_cache.bin` being a
  build dependency of `subset_julia_vm` (via `include_bytes!`), every script
  run invalidated the rlib and forced a full `subset_julia_vm_web` WASM
  relink under `lto = true` — that relink dominated the lag in
  `scripts/wasm_build_with_cache.sh`.
- Added `compile::sorted_serde` with `sorted_hashmap` /
  `sorted_hashmap_of_hashset` `serialize_with` helpers and applied them to
  `SerializedBaseCache.method_tables`, `SerializedBaseCache.closure_captures`,
  and `MethodTable.struct_parents`. Sorted `promotion_rules` before storing
  it in the cache. Deserialization is unchanged.
- `scripts/wasm_build_with_cache.sh` now skips Base cache regeneration when
  the existing cache is newer than the prelude sources and `sjulia` binary,
  with a `--force-cache` opt-out.
- Regression test
  `tests/sjulia_precompile_determinism_tests.rs` spawns sjulia twice in
  independent processes and asserts byte-identical cache output.

### Plots plot! current-series append (Issue #4410)

- Added embedded `Plots.plot!` exports and line-series append variants for
  `plot!(f::Function)`, `plot!(y::Vector)`, and `plot!(x, y)`.
- `plot(...)` now records the current series vector so `plot!(...)` mutates the
  current series set and returns a plot containing the appended line series.
- Added package fixture coverage for `plot(sin); plot!(cos)`, a repeated
  `plot!` append, `plot!(y)`, and `plot!(x, y)`.

### NewStructSplat Array logical read (Issue #3908)

- Routed `NewStructSplat` Array argument expansion through
  `ArrayValue::get_linear()` instead of raw `arr_borrow.data.get_value(...)`.
- Extended `scripts/check_array_public_data_access.sh` so the
  `vm/exec/struct_ops.rs` Array splat path cannot return to raw storage reads.

### IndexStoreTyped StructRefs helper (Issue #3908)

- Routed typed `setindex!` handling for heap-backed struct arrays through
  `ArrayValue::is_struct_ref_array()` instead of directly matching
  `ArrayData::StructRefs` in `vm/exec/array_index.rs`.
- Extended `scripts/check_array_public_data_access.sh` so direct
  `ArrayData::StructRefs` references cannot return to `array_index.rs`.

### Array push StructRefs helper (Issue #3908)

- Routed native `push!` Array builtin handling for heap-backed struct arrays
  through `ArrayValue::is_struct_ref_array()` and `ArrayValue::push()`.
- Removed direct `ArrayData::StructRefs` mutation from `vm/builtins_arrays.rs`,
  keeping this public mutation fallback behind ArrayValue helper APIs.
- Extended `scripts/check_array_public_data_access.sh` so direct
  `ArrayData::StructRefs` references cannot return to `builtins_arrays.rs`.

### Generator Array indexing logical read (Issue #3908)

- Routed the retained `Generator` indexing fallback over Array inputs through
  `ArrayValue::get_linear()` instead of reading `arr.data.get_value(...)`
  directly in `vm/exec/array_index.rs`.
- Extended `scripts/check_array_public_data_access.sh` so future raw
  `data.get_value` reads in `array_index.rs` fail the audit.

### typed array literal StructRefs helper (Issue #3908)

- Added `ArrayValue::is_struct_ref_array()` so typed array literal builders can
  classify heap-backed struct array storage without matching raw
  `ArrayData::StructRefs` in `vm/exec/array_basic.rs`.
- Routed `PushElemTyped` struct and Rational scalar conversion through the
  shared `ArrayValue::push()` helper, keeping builder mutation behind
  `ArrayValue` instead of editing raw storage vectors in the instruction path.
- Tightened `scripts/check_array_literal_memory_first.sh` to reject future
  direct `ArrayData::StructRefs` inspection in array literal builders.

### Array/Memory migration inventory refreshed (Issue #3908)

- Updated `docs/vm/ARRAY_MEMORY_MIGRATION.md` current inventory from the latest
  `rg` audit counts: `Value::Array` 238, `Value::Memory` 171,
  `memory_to_array_ref` 0, and 92 files touching Array representation surfaces.
- Reworded the migration direction to reflect the current Memory-first state:
  the `memory_to_array_ref` bridge is retired and held at zero, while remaining
  `Value::Array` references are classified compatibility boundaries or
  transitional native Array surfaces.

### array_index Value::Array allowlist tightened (Issue #3908)

- Lowered the `scripts/check_value_array_allowlist.sh` ceiling for
  `vm/exec/array_index.rs` from 23 to the current 22 `Value::Array` references.
- This keeps the generic indexing compatibility boundary from expanding while
  Array wrapper indexing migration continues.

### builtins_exec Value::Array allowlist removed (Issue #3908)

- Removed `builtins_exec.rs` from `scripts/check_value_array_allowlist.sh`.
- `builtins_exec.rs` now has zero `Value::Array` / `ArrayData` / `ArrayValue`
  references; any reintroduction is treated as an unexpected Array boundary.

### Array first/last fallback removed from builtins_exec (Issue #3908)

- Removed the `Value::Array` branches from the retained internal
  `BuiltinId::TupleFirst` / `BuiltinId::TupleLast` fallback in
  `builtins_exec.rs`.
- Public `first(::Array)` / `last(::Array)` continue through Pure Julia
  indexing (`arr[1]` / `arr[length(arr)]`), while the internal fallback remains
  for tuple, range, string, and struct compatibility.

### Dead Array reshape/mutation fallback removed from builtins_exec (Issue #3908)

- Removed unreachable legacy `BuiltinId::Reshape` / `BuiltinId::Push` /
  `BuiltinId::Pop` fallback arms from `builtins_exec.rs`.
- `builtins_arrays.rs` remains the dispatch-chain owner for these operations,
  so the duplicate `Value::Array` reshape and mutation fallback surface is gone.

### Dead deepcopy fallback removed from builtins_exec (Issue #3908)

- Removed the unreachable legacy `BuiltinId::Deepcopy` fallback arm from
  `builtins_exec.rs`.
- `builtins_reflection` remains the dispatch-chain owner, so Array deep copy
  stays on the active Memory-first logical copy path without a duplicate
  fallback surface.

### Dead string fallback removed from builtins_exec (Issue #3908)

- Removed unreachable legacy string builtin fallback arms from
  `builtins_exec.rs`; `builtins_strings.rs` remains the dispatch-chain owner.
- This deletes the old fallback `codeunits(::String)` Array materialization from
  the compatibility surface while preserving the active string handler path.

### Dead type fallback removed from builtins_exec (Issue #3908)

- Removed the unreachable legacy `BuiltinId::TypeOf` / `BuiltinId::Isa` /
  `BuiltinId::Subtype` fallback arms from `builtins_exec.rs`.
- `builtins_types.rs` remains the dispatch-chain owner for those operations,
  including the active Array reflection path that uses the centralized
  `ArrayValue` element-type projection helper.

### Dead zeros/ones fallback removed from builtins_exec (Issue #3908)

- Removed the unreachable legacy `BuiltinId::Zeros` / `BuiltinId::Ones`
  fallback arms from `builtins_exec.rs`.
- `builtins_arrays.rs` remains the dispatch-chain owner for those constructors,
  and it uses Memory-first `ArrayValue` helpers instead of the old
  `ArrayValue::zeros` / `ArrayValue::ones` fallback path.

### zero Array fallback preserves logical element type (Issue #4419)

- The retained native `zero(::Array)` fallback now allocates its result from
  `ArrayValue::element_type()` through Memory-first typed allocation instead of
  unconditionally using `ArrayValue::zeros` / `Float64` storage.
- `zero([1, 2, 3])` now preserves `Vector{Int64}`, and `zero([true, false])`
  preserves `Vector{Bool}` while #3908 continues moving public Array behavior
  toward Pure Julia wrapper dispatch.

### Array literal PushElem uses ArrayValue mutation helper (Issue #3908)

- The retained untyped array literal `PushElem` VM builder now grows through
  `ArrayValue::push_f64()` instead of directly pushing into raw
  `ArrayData::F64` storage and patching shape by hand.
- The array literal Memory-first audit now rejects direct raw F64 builder
  mutation in `array_basic.rs`, keeping literal growth behind ArrayValue
  mutation helpers while the transitional `Value::Array` builder remains.

### Any array trait projection preserves declared element type (Issue #4416)

- Public `eltype(::Array)`, `valtype(::Array)`, and native `typeof(::Array)`
  now use declared Array element metadata, while dispatch-facing projection
  keeps its runtime specialization helper.
- `Vector{Any}` containing user structs once again reports `Any` / `Vector{Any}`
  rather than over-projecting from the first runtime element.

### Array type trait projection uses shared logical metadata (Issue #3908)

- `eltype(::Array)`, `valtype(::Array)`, dispatch-facing Array type
  projection, and native `typeof(::Array)` now use centralized
  `ArrayValue` element-type projection helpers.
- User-struct array element tags are preserved at the collection trait boundary
  instead of degrading through the raw `ArrayElementType` conversion fallback.

### Slice index arrays read logical elements (Issue #3908)

- Pure Julia `Array` wrapper now supports Int64 index vectors and Bool masks in
  `getindex`, covering reshaped wrapper indices through normal dispatch.
- Typed array indexing no longer stores `IndexLoadTyped` results into scalar
  slots when the index is dynamic, preserving runtime array-index selection.
- The retained native slice fallback also converts index vectors and masks
  through logical `ArrayValue::get_linear()` reads instead of raw `ArrayData`
  access, so shared backing storage remains visible during the migration.

### String from Array reads logical elements (Issue #3908)

- `String(::Array)` character conversion now reads Array inputs through
  `ArrayValue::get_linear()` instead of matching raw `ArrayData::Char` /
  `ArrayData::Any` storage.
- Pure Julia Array wrapper `_mem::Array` compatibility inputs from reshape now
  use the same logical projection, with the `Value::Array` audit documenting
  this temporary boundary.

### Matmul results use Memory-first materialization (Issue #3908)

- Retained real-valued matmul and scalar-vector compatibility kernels now build
  result arrays through `ArrayValue::memory_first_from_f64()` instead of the
  legacy constructor alias.
- Public LinearAlgebra dispatch migration remains tracked by #4020; this slice
  only tightens the storage boundary for the native compatibility result path.

### HOF input normalization uses Memory-first materialization (Issue #3908)

- `pop_array_or_values` now rebuilds logical numeric HOF fallback inputs through
  `ArrayValue::memory_first_from_f64()` instead of direct `ArrayValue::from_f64`.
- The broadcast/HOF Memory-first audit now covers this HOF input normalization
  boundary as well as result builders.

### HOF dispatch result arrays use Memory-first materialization (Issue #3908)

- F64-mode HOF dispatch result builders now materialize Broadcast/FindAll
  result storage through Memory-first `ArrayValue` helpers instead of direct
  `ArrayValue::from_*` constructors.
- The broadcast/HOF Memory-first audit now covers `hof_exec/dispatch.rs`, so
  retained HOF compatibility paths cannot reintroduce direct typed result
  storage.

### RNG/range VM arrays use Memory-first materialization (Issue #3908)

- Retained VM `rand`/`randn` array-producing instructions now materialize
  result storage through `ArrayValue::memory_first_from_f64()` before returning
  the transitional Array wrapper.
- Legacy eager `MakeRange` / `MakeRangeF64` compatibility instructions now use
  Memory-first `ArrayValue` helpers, keeping old bytecode boundaries aligned
  with the Array/Memory migration.

### String index vectors compile to slice path (Issue #3908)

- `getindex(s::String, idxs::Array)` compile lowering now treats Array-like
  indices as `IndexSlice` inputs instead of coercing them through scalar
  `DynamicToI64`.
- The runtime String slice boundary now selects each logical integer vector
  index independently, keeping `s[[i, j]]` aligned with Julia instead of
  treating index vectors as continuous ranges.

### Array iteration/in uses logical ArrayValue element reads (Issue #3908)

- Array iteration next-state handling and the direct `in(x, array)` native
  fallback now read Array elements through `ArrayValue::get_linear()` instead
  of raw `ArrayData` storage.
- Complex arrays now compare against logical `Complex{T}` elements, avoiding
  false negatives for `Complex` probes and false positives from interleaved
  real storage components.

### Array sizeof uses logical ArrayValue element type (Issue #3908)

- `sizeof(::Array)` native fallback now calculates element bytes from
  `ArrayValue::element_type()` instead of raw `ArrayData` storage tags.
- Logical Complex array metadata is now preserved for byte-size projection, so
  `Vector{Complex{Float64}}` counts 16 bytes per element rather than the
  interleaved `Float64` storage width.

### IndexStore scalar conversion uses logical ArrayValue element type (Issue #3908)

- Numeric `IndexStore` fallback now converts scalar values from
  `ArrayValue::element_type()` instead of matching raw `ArrayData` storage.
- Complex arrays can now accept real scalar stores as `Complex{T}` values while
  Bool and integer arrays still preserve their logical element conversion.

### Array isa uses logical ArrayValue type projection (Issue #3908)

- `isa(::Array, ::Type)` native fallback now reuses
  `Vm::get_value_julia_type` for Array values instead of reconstructing the
  Array type from raw `ArrayData` tags.
- This keeps `isa(zeros(Complex{Float64}, n), Vector{Complex{Float64}})`
  aligned with logical `ArrayValue::element_type()` metadata and avoids treating
  interleaved Complex storage as `Vector{Float64}`.

### Array runtime_type uses shared logical element projection (Issue #3908)

- `Value::runtime_type(::Array)` now uses the shared logical
  `ArrayElementType` to `JuliaType` projection helper instead of carrying a
  separate manual element-type conversion table.
- Tuple-array runtime type projection now preserves nested logical field types
  such as `Tuple{Complex{Float64}}` instead of degrading unsupported tuple
  fields to `Any`.

### Array dispatch type projection uses logical ArrayValue element type (Issue #3908)

- Runtime dispatch type projection for `Value::Array` now derives element types
  from `ArrayValue::element_type()` plus shared logical projection instead of
  falling back to raw `ArrayData` tags for primitive storage.
- Struct array special cases still consult `struct_defs` / `struct_heap`, while
  logical tags such as `Complex{Float64}` remain visible when erased Array
  values are matched against parametric method signatures.

### Array valtype uses logical ArrayValue element type (Issue #3908)

- `valtype(::Array)` now reads `ArrayValue::element_type()` instead of raw
  `ArrayData::element_type()`, so logical element metadata such as
  `Complex{Float64}` remains visible at the collection trait boundary.
- `ArrayElementType` to `JuliaType` projection is now shared from the value
  layer, keeping `eltype` tuple-field projection and `valtype` on the same
  logical type conversion path.

### LinearAlgebra fallback inputs use logical ArrayValue reads (Issue #3908)

- LinearAlgebra native compatibility kernels now read numeric Array inputs
  through `ArrayValue::to_logical_f64_vec()` instead of `try_as_f64_vec()`.
- This preserves reshaped/shared ArrayValue projection at the remaining native
  linalg boundary while #4020 tracks moving the public LinearAlgebra behavior
  fully behind Pure Julia / stdlib dispatch.

### HOF F64 fallback starts use logical ArrayValue reads (Issue #3908)

- Retained VM HOF F64 fallback entry points now read source arrays through
  `ArrayValue::to_logical_f64_vec()` instead of `try_as_f64_vec()`.
- This keeps mapreduce/mapfoldr/map!/filter!/sum/count compatibility fallback
  startup aligned with reshaped/shared ArrayValue projection while public HOF
  behavior continues moving toward Pure Julia dispatch.

### HOF array popping uses logical ArrayValue reads (Issue #3908)

- `pop_array_or_values` now classifies arrays through `ArrayValue::element_type`
  and reads non-F64 / shared storage through `to_logical_f64_vec` or
  `to_logical_value_vec` instead of matching raw `ArrayData` variants.
- Plain non-shared Float64 arrays still use the existing by-reference fast path,
  while typed integer, complex, tuple, struct, and reshaped arrays follow the
  logical ArrayValue projection boundary.

### filter! HOF fallback rebuilds Memory-first storage (Issue #3908)

- The retained VM `FilterInPlace` HOF compatibility fallback now rebuilds its
  filtered destination through `ArrayValue::memory_first_from_f64()` instead of
  assigning `ArrayData::F64` directly.
- Public `filter!(f, a::Array)` remains on the Pure Julia method path; this
  keeps old bytecode fallback storage construction aligned with the
  Memory-first Array boundary.

### Range count uses Pure Julia dispatch with Memory-first fallback (Issue #3908)

- `count(f, r::AbstractRange)` now has a Pure Julia range method that iterates
  the range directly, matching upstream `count(f, itr)` behavior without
  routing public Range count through native Array materialization.
- The retained VM `CountFunc` compatibility fallback now materializes
  `Value::Range` through `RangeValue::collect()` instead of hand-building a
  Float64 array, so old bytecode also preserves integer range element types.

### Range pop_array materialization uses Memory-first collect (Issue #3908)

- `StackOps::pop_array` now materializes `Value::Range` through
  `RangeValue::collect()` instead of hand-building a Float64 array.
- This keeps the compatibility auto-collect path on the same Memory-first range
  materialization used by public `collect`, including Int64 element
  preservation for integer ranges.

### Matmul helpers use logical ArrayValue reads (Issue #3908)

- Real-valued matmul/scalar-vector extraction now reads through
  `ArrayValue::to_logical_f64_vec` instead of cloning raw typed `ArrayData`.
- Complex matmul extraction now reads each logical element through
  `ArrayValue::get_linear`, preserving reshaped/shared parent projection for
  interleaved Complex arrays and struct-reference arrays.

### Array index-array extraction uses logical ArrayValue reads (Issue #3908)

- Runtime array indexing with array-valued indices now derives selected indices
  through `ArrayValue::get_linear` instead of reading raw `ArrayData` directly.
- Boolean mask, F64 boolean-like, and I64 index-array modes are centralized in a
  helper so reshaped/shared ArrayValue parents remain visible during index
  extraction.

### Array deep copy uses Memory-first logical copy (Issue #3908)

- `deep_copy_value(::Array)` now copies through
  `ArrayValue::memory_first_copy_from_array` instead of cloning raw
  `ArrayData` into a new wrapper.
- Array deep copy now reads logical elements through the existing ArrayValue
  projection path and rebuilds independent Memory-first storage for the
  transitional `Value::Array` result.

### Dynamic complex broadcast bridge uses Memory-first Array helpers (Issue #3908)

- Dynamic broadcast's struct-ref Complex array bridge now materializes
  interleaved `ComplexF64` storage through `ArrayValue::complex_f64` instead of
  directly constructing an `ArrayValue` with a manual element-type override.
- The bridge remains a transitional native Array boundary, but its storage
  construction now follows the same Memory-first path as other complex array
  helpers.

### ArrayValue legacy constructors use Memory-first storage construction (Issue #3908)

- `ArrayValue::new` now routes already-materialized `ArrayData` through the
  shared Memory-first materialization helper before returning the transitional
  `ArrayValue` wrapper.
- `ArrayValue::with_struct_type` now preserves `StructOf(type_id)` /
  `struct_type_id` while moving the struct-reference storage owner behind
  `MemoryValue`.

### Tuple and isbits ArrayValue helpers use Memory-first storage construction (Issue #3908)

- `ArrayValue::tuple_array`, `with_tuple_capacity`, `isbits_struct_array`, and
  `with_isbits_struct_capacity` now route through existing Memory-first
  materialization/capacity helpers.
- Logical `TupleOf(...)` and `StructInlineOf(...)` overrides, including
  `struct_type_id`, are preserved while storage ownership moves behind
  `MemoryValue`.

### Primitive ArrayValue helpers use Memory-first storage construction (Issue #3908)

- Legacy `ArrayValue::from_f64`, `from_i64`, `from_bool`, vector aliases,
  `zeros` / `ones`, `fill`, and primitive `undef_*` helpers now route through
  Memory-first construction before returning the transitional `ArrayValue`.
- Added a shared internal `memory_first_from_array_data*` path so primitive,
  boxed override, and `undef_typed` materialization share the same
  `MemoryValue` owner setup.

### Complex Array helpers use Memory-first storage construction (Issue #3908)

- `ArrayValue::complex_f64` / `complex_f32` を `MemoryValue` 経由で作るようにし、
  interleaved real storage + logical `ComplexF64` / `ComplexF32` override の形を
  Memory-first helper に集約。
- `zeros_complex_f64`, `zeros_complex_f32`, `undef_complex_f64`, and
  `undef_typed(::ComplexF32)` も同じ helper 経由へ移行。public boundary は
  transitional `ArrayValue` のままだが、complex array materialization の storage
  owner は #3908 の Memory primitive first 方向に寄せた。

### String/Any materialization uses Memory-first Array helpers (Issue #3908)

- `ArrayValue::memory_first_from_u8` / `memory_first_from_strings` を追加し、
  `codeunits`, regex `split`, `eachmatch`, `subtypes` の小さな Vector
  materialization path を直接 `ArrayData` owner から Memory-first helper 経由へ
  移行。
- `ArrayValue::any_vector` も `MemoryValue` 経由で transitional `ArrayValue` を
  作るように変更。public return は互換境界として `Value::Array` のままだが、
  storage construction は #3908 の Memory primitive first 方向に寄せた。

### Array builtin Value::Array allowlist tightened (Issue #3908)

- `scripts/check_value_array_allowlist.sh` の `vm/builtins_arrays.rs` ceiling を
  実数に合わせて 10 → 9 に縮小。
- runtime behavior は変更なし。#3908 の Array/Memory 境界移行で、public
  Array builtin construction/fallback surface が再拡大しないよう監査を締めた。

### Scalar backslash preserves division fallback with user ldiv methods (Issue #4353)

- `Base.:\(A::Matrix{Float64}, b::Vector{Float64})` のような user method が
  存在するだけで、未一致の scalar `2 \ 4` が VM `Ldiv` matrix solve fallback
  に落ちる regression を修正。
- `CallTypedDispatchOrBuiltin(BuiltinId::Ldiv, ...)` の runtime candidate miss
  では、左辺が array-like の場合のみ retained `Ldiv` kernel へ fallback する。
