  scalar 左辺では本家 Julia と同じ `a \ b == b / a` として `dynamic_div(b, a)`
  に戻す。
- Regression: `linalg_ldiv_dispatch_first_4020` に direct scalar と `Any`
  wrapper scalar cases を追加。matrix/vector user method dispatch-first behavior
  は維持。

### Bool return-type annotation preserves Bool static dispatch (Issue #4376)

- `function f()::Bool; true; end; println(f())` が `1` を出力する不具合を修正。
  `using Primes; println(isprime(17))` も同じ理由で `1` を出力していた。
  CLI / iOS / Web すべてに影響していた compiler バグ。
- 原因は `subset_julia_vm_compile/src/compile/type_helpers.rs::julia_type_to_value_type`
  で `JuliaType::Bool` を `ValueType::I64` に型消去していたこと。`::Bool` 戻り
  アノテーションが付くと呼び出し側で静的に Int64 として扱われ、`println` の
  経路 (`compile/expr/builtin_io.rs`) が `PrintI64NoNewline` を発行し、Bool 値が
  整数として印字されていた。`typeof` は runtime の `Value::Bool` タグを見るので
  Bool を返す——静的型と runtime 型がずれていた。
- Fix: `JuliaType::Bool => ValueType::Bool`。`ValueType::Bool` は既にリテラル /
  比較演算で使われている variant で、`compile/stmt.rs:232` で `Instr::ReturnI64`
  に流れる経路もそのまま (`preserved_val` で Bool タグは保存される)。
- Regression: `bool_return_type_annotation` fixture (multiple dispatch で
  `foo(::Bool)` vs `foo(::Int64)` を区別)。

## 最新対応 (2026-05-23)

### Web build: bundled packages reachable via pipeline (Issue #4373)

- WebAssembly Playground で `using Primes; factor(10)` が
  `Runtime error: ErrorException: Unknown function: factor` で失敗していた。
  CLI / iOS では同じコードが通っており、Web のみで再現する不整合だった。
- 原因は `subset_julia_vm_web/src/lib.rs::run_from_source_internal` が
  `pipeline::parse_and_lower` をバイパスし、独自に `Lowering::new` →
  `compile_core_program` だけ呼んでいたこと。`PackageLoader::load_for_usings`
  (`@stdlib:@packages`) が走らないため、`subset_julia_vm/packages/` 配下の
  Primes / Plots / Example が IR に取り込まれていなかった。
- Fix: WASM エントリを `parse_and_lower` 経由に統一。CLI / iOS と同じ前処理
  (prelude マージ + PackageLoader による using 解決) を共有する。
- Regression: `subset_julia_vm_web::tests::test_bundled_primes_factor`,
  `test_bundled_primes_isprime`。

### REPL: suppress struct text when SVG artifact attached (Issue #4369)

- iOS REPL で `using Plots; plot(sin)` 等の Plot を表示すると、SVG
  チャートに加えて `<struct ref>` や
  `Plots.Plot([StructRef(heap_idx=N)], :text)` の冗長なテキストが
  併記される問題を修正。
- `repl_session_eval` (FFI) が `display_artifact.is_some()` のときに
  `CREPLResult.value` を null にして返すよう変更。チャートが既に値の意味を
  担っているためテキストは不要。
- 非 Plot な結果 (`1 + 2` → `3`) はこれまでどおり値テキストを表示。

### Editor tab renders SVG plot artifact (Issue #4366)

- iOS の Editor タブで `using Plots; plot(sin)` を実行しても `[Time] ...`
  しか出ない問題を修正。
- `compile_and_run_detailed` / `compile_and_run_streaming` が返す
  `CExecutionResult` を `artifact_mime` / `artifact_data` 付きに拡張し、
  `try_value_to_artifact` を経由して SVG を Swift 側へ橋渡しする。
- Swift の `ExecutionResult` に `plotSVG: String?` が乗り、`ContentView`
  の Editor 出力に既存の `PlotPreviewView` (WKWebView) を inline で描画。
- Run / Clear で plot 領域がリセットされる。

### Plots: scatter shorthand (Issue #4367)

- 本家 Plots.jl の `@shorthands scatter` (≡ `plot(...; seriestype=:scatter)`)
  に相当する `scatter(x, y)` / `scatter(y::Vector)` / `scatter(f::Function)`
  をバンドル版 `Plots` に追加。`Series` に `seriestype` フィールドを足し、
  既存の 3 引数コンストラクタは inner constructor で `:line` をデフォルト
  にして後方互換を維持。
- Rust `src/plotting/svg.rs` が seriestype を読み、`:scatter` 時は
  `<circle cx cy r fill>` を、`:line` 時は従来の `<path>` を描画。
- 非本家の `text_plot` / `svg_plot` (および `text.jl`, `svg.jl`,
  `backends/GRBackend.jl`) は削除。自動表示パスは Rust 側で完結している
  ため挙動への影響なし。

### Plots.plot(f::Function) default xlims = (-5, 5) (Issue #4364)

- `subset_julia_vm/packages/Plots/src/api.jl::plot(f::Function)` がサンプル
  範囲を `1:100` の整数列から `[-5.0, 5.0]` の等間隔 100 点に変更され、
  本家 Plots.jl の `RecipesPipeline/src/user_recipe.jl:219-233` の挙動
  (`xlims` 未指定時に `PlotUtils.tryrange` 経由で `xmin = -5, xmax = 5`
  に解決される) と一致するようになった。
- iOS REPL の `plot(sin)` が、約 15.9 周期の高周波サンプルではなく、
  本家 GR バックエンドと同じく `[-5, 5]` 上の 1 周期+α の滑らかな sin 波
  としてレンダリングされる。
- フィクスチャ `plots_function_sin.jl` が x 範囲と端点での y 値を assert。

### Plots auto-SVG artifact missed module-qualified names (Issue #4361)

- iOS REPL で `using Plots; plot(sin)` を実行しても画像が出ず、フォールバックの
  `<struct ref>` が表示される問題を修正。
- 原因は `subset_julia_vm_vm/src/plotting/svg.rs` の `Plot`/`Series` 判定が
  `struct_name` を素の名前と厳密一致させており、`using Plots` 経由で VM が
  保持する `Plots.Plot`/`Plots.Series` にマッチしなかったこと。
- 既存の Plots フィクスチャは `svg_plot(p)` を明示的に呼ぶか
  `p.series` を見るだけで、REPL の自動表示パス
  (`REPLSession::eval` → `try_value_to_artifact`) を通っていなかったため
  検出できていなかった。
- 修正後は `display_artifact` が `image/svg+xml` で立ち、Swift 側の
  `plotSVG` が SVG を受け取って `PlotPreviewView` がレンダリングする。

### Top-level docstring drop in lowering (Issue #4357)

- `lower_source_file` and `lower_module_definition` now skip a top-level
  `StringLiteral` CST node when its next non-comment sibling is a definition
  (function/struct/abstract/macro/module/baremodule/const/short-fn/lambda/
  `@kwdef`). This matches Julia's `"""doc""" function f end` ≡
  `@doc "doc" function f end` convention.
- Previously the asyncmap docstring (last file in `base/get_base()`) leaked as
  the REPL return value of any input whose user `main` was empty, e.g.
  `using LinearAlgebra` or `struct Foo end`.

### String/Char multiplication Union vararg dispatch parity (Issues #3671/#4350)

- `Base.:*` for string/char concatenation now uses the upstream-shaped
  `Union{AbstractChar, AbstractString}` vararg method signature instead of
  four explicit two-argument methods.
- `hasmethod(*, Tuple{String, Char, String})` now matches upstream Julia, while
  slice-indexed string concatenation still stays on runtime dispatch rather
  than falling into `MatMul`.

## 最新対応 (2026-05-22)

### isvalid dispatch-first routing (Issue #4352)

- Public `Base.isvalid` now goes through normal method dispatch before the
  retained Rust UTF-8 boundary fallback.
- `BASE_FUNCTION_ROUTES` and `PUBLIC_FALLBACKS.md` classify `isvalid` as
  `DispatchFirst`, matching the existing `ncodeunits` / `codeunit` /
  `codeunits` string boundary routes.

### Peephole compare-jump fusion respects branch targets (Issue #4351)

- Peephole optimization now refuses to fuse a compare instruction with a
  following conditional jump when any consumed instruction after the first is
  also a jump target.
- This preserves short-circuit control-flow joins such as
  `(5 > 3 || 5 > 10) ? 1 : 0`, matching upstream Julia semantics and avoiding
  VM stack underflow.

### String/Char multiplication dispatch parity (Issues #3671/#4350)

- `String` / `Char` two-argument `*` methods are now available through Pure
  Julia Base dispatch, mirroring the binary surface of upstream
  `*(::Union{AbstractChar,AbstractString}, ...)`.
- The compiler keeps slice-indexed `*` expressions on runtime dispatch instead
  of locking `Array * Array` into `MatMul`, so `s[1:2] * s[3:4]` reaches the
  string concatenation method.

### Narrow integer fused slot preservation (Issue #4349)

- Fused VM slot arithmetic for `LoadAddI64Slot`, `LoadSubI64Slot`,
  `LoadMulI64Slot`, and `LoadModI64Slot` now preserves the runtime narrow
  integer storage kind when the slot contains `Int8`/`Int16`/`Int32`/`UInt*`.
- This keeps representative typed-parameter integer-width fixtures on the VM
  fast path without forcing every fused slot operation through `Int64`.

### Membership alias dispatch-first `in` delegation (Issue #3911)

- `∉`, `∋`, and `∌` call sites now delegate directly to runtime
  dispatch-first `in` when there is no specific user method for the alias
  itself.
- This avoids executing cached Base alias wrappers that retained an early VM
  `in` builtin fallback and missed later `Base.in(::UserType, ::UserBox)`
  extensions.

### Module struct DataType identity normalization (Issue #4348)

- Runtime `DataType` identity now normalizes imported module struct aliases for
  `===` / `!==`, so `typeof(s) === MyStruct{Int64}` matches upstream Julia when
  `s` was constructed from a module-qualified `TestModule.MyStruct{Int64}`.
- Existing `isa` behavior remains unchanged; the fix closes the identity side
  of `module_struct_isa`.

### IOBuffer/empty Tuple show runtime dispatch (Issue #4347)

- Runtime typed dispatch now applies subtype fallback to ordinary candidate
  parameters, so `IOBuffer <: IO` and `Tuple{} <: Tuple` are considered when
  selecting `show` methods.
- `show(buf, ())` now reaches `show(::IO, ::Tuple)` instead of falling back to
  the first specific `show` candidate (`CartesianIndex`).

### Pair expression construction and display (Issue #4346)

- Pair expressions now construct the Pure Julia `Pair` struct when available,
  while retaining tuple-like fallback behavior.
- `show(::Pair)` indexes through untyped helpers so runtime tuple-like Pair
  representations still display as `a => b`.

### gcdx integer recurrence parity (Issue #4345)

- Pure Julia `gcdx` now uses `div(old_r, r)` instead of `floor(old_r / r)`,
  preventing Float64 leakage into the integer recurrence.

### Runtime varargs specialization binding (Issue #4344)

- The runtime specializer binds varargs parameters as `Tuple`, matching the
  VM calling convention instead of pinning the slot to the first argument type.

### @kwdef default constructor fallback (Issue #4343)

- Struct constructor fallback now allows exact field-layout construction for
  mutable structs generated by `@kwdef` while preserving normal method dispatch
  for immutable structs.

### iOS Random Simulation floor-name compatibility (Issue #4342)

- The iOS Random/Dice Simulation sample no longer shadows Base `floor`; its
  local helper is named `integer_floor`.
- The VM diagnostic for typed I64 slot load/add failures now includes the slot
  name and runtime value, making future sample failures easier to localize.

### Complex function-value trig return typing (Issue #4341)

- Top-level/global inference no longer classifies Pure Julia math calls with
  Complex/Any arguments as guaranteed `Float64`.
- Function-value intrinsic fallback for `sin` / `cos` / `tan` / `exp` / `log`
  now only handles primitive numeric arguments; Complex values stay on the
  Pure Julia dispatch path.
- Complex math call-site return typing now avoids stale `Float64` method
  metadata for Complex-returning overloads, so `r = tan(z::Complex{Float64})`
  no longer emits `StoreF64`.

### Complex reshape element-type preservation (Issue #4340)

- Pure Julia Array wrapper type projection now recognizes legacy native
  `ArrayValue` storage in the wrapper `_mem` field, not only `Memory{T}`.
- `reshape(Vector{Complex{Float64}}(undef, 4), 2, 2)` now reports
  `Matrix{Complex{Float64}}` and `eltype(...) == Complex{Float64}`, matching
  upstream Julia for the representative direct reshape case.
- The iOS Mandelbrot 2D broadcast sample now allocates and reports the
  Complex broadcast destination correctly before producing `Matrix{Int64}`.

### BigInt/BigFloat abstract numeric VM return preservation (Issue #4337)

- Numeric constructor inference now recognizes `big(...)`, `BigInt`,
  `BigFloat`, and fixed-width numeric constructors before collecting global
  binding types.
- VM binary dispatch keeps BigInt/BigFloat operands on intrinsic runtime paths
  even when one side is `Any` or an abstract numeric parameter.
- Functions with abstract numeric parameters widen concrete numeric inferred
  returns to `Any`, preventing callers from emitting typed slot stores that
  reject valid `BigInt` / `BigFloat` runtime results.
- `sign(::BigInt)` now preserves `BigInt`, matching upstream Julia for the
  representative `abs` / `abs2` / `sign` preservation fixture.

### Broadcast logical indexing inference parity (Issue #4338)

- Materialized broadcast comparisons infer Boolean arrays, so expressions like
  `xs[xs .> 2]` are compiled as logical indexing instead of scalar integer
  indexing.
- Typed and builtin `getindex` paths now treat Julia Array wrapper index values
  as array-like indices instead of coercing them through the Int64 scalar path.

### Matrix rotation literal overload parity (Issue #4336)

- Pure Julia Base now provides Matrix overload coverage for `rotl90`, `rotr90`,
  and `rot180` on the VM-supported element types plus `Any`.
- Matrix literal rank inference from #4020 can therefore expose the same
  matrix-specific rotation route that upstream Julia selects, rather than
  falling through missing `Matrix` method coverage.

### REPL Pure Julia Array wrapper persistence (Issue #4335)

- REPL struct persistence now recognizes Pure Julia `Array{T}` wrappers and
  serializes their current logical storage values with the wrapper shape.
- This restores persistence for `mat = reshape(base, 2, 2)` across REPL
  evaluations when `reshape` returns the Memory-backed Pure Julia wrapper.

### Reshape BuiltinOp reachability audit fix (Issue #4334)

- Restored `reshape` to the `base_function_to_builtin_op()` reachability audit
  inputs. `reshape` remains dispatch-first with a retained VM fallback, so
  `BuiltinOp::Reshape` is live even though it is no longer emitted by
  lowering-time `map_builtin_name()`.

### LinearAlgebra matrix literal direct dispatch parity (Issue #4020)

- `ArrayLiteral` type inference now preserves literal rank from lowering
  shape metadata instead of treating every homogeneous array literal as
  `Vector{T}`.
- Matrix literals such as `[1.0 0.0; 0.0 1.0]` now infer as `Matrix{Float64}`,
  so imported/user `LinearAlgebra` methods for `Matrix{Float64}` are selected
  before the retained VM/native fallback for direct calls.
- Added `linalg_matrix_literal_direct_dispatch_4020`, verified against upstream
  Julia and direct sjulia for `mul!`, `ldiv!`, `rdiv!`, `tr`, `opnorm`, and
  `diag`.

### LinearAlgebra backslash dispatch-first routing (Issue #4020)

- `A \ b` now tries imported/user `Base.:\` methods through runtime typed
  dispatch before the retained VM `Ldiv` kernel when user methods exist.
- This fixes both statically inferred matrix/vector calls and `A::Any, b::Any`
  wrappers, matching upstream Julia for `\(A::Matrix{Float64},
  b::Vector{Float64})`.
- LinearAlgebra kernels now accept the Pure Julia `Array` wrapper produced by
  `reshape`, so `rank(reshape(v, 1, n))` can reach `svd` without a
  `StructRef` type error.
- Added `linalg_ldiv_dispatch_first_4020`, verified against upstream Julia and
  direct sjulia. Existing `linalg_rank_basic` covers the reshape wrapper path.

### Membership operator runtime fallback dispatch parity (Issue #4276)

- `in(x, collection)` now routes user methods through runtime typed dispatch
  before the retained membership fallback when user extension methods are
  present.
- Binary membership aliases `∈`, `∉`, `∋`, and `∌` now lower to their public
  callable names instead of directly rewriting to `in` / `!in`, so user methods
  on those names can win like upstream Julia.
- If the runtime collection type does not match the user method signature, for
  example `Vector{Any}` versus `Vector{Int64}`, sjulia falls back to the VM
  membership path instead of calling the mismatched method.
- Added `dispatch_in_user_method_4276`, verified against upstream Julia, for
  direct `in`, operator `∈` / `∉` / `∋` / `∌`, and `Any`-typed calls.

### Array `push!` runtime fallback dispatch parity (Issue #4276)

- `push!`, `pop!`, `pushfirst!`, `popfirst!`, `insert!`, and `deleteat!` now
  route user methods through runtime typed dispatch before the retained VM array
  mutation fallback when user extension methods are present.
- `pop!` / `popfirst!` use a result-aware fallback path so the VM drops the
  modified array value left by the primitive fallback and returns only the
  popped element, while the array reference remains mutated in place.
- If the runtime array type does not match the user method signature, for
  example `Vector{Any}` versus `Vector{Int64}`, sjulia falls back to the VM
  array mutation path instead of calling the mismatched method.
- Extended `dispatch_collection_mutation_user_method_4276` with the upstream
  Julia cases where `Vector{Int64}` mutation methods must not intercept
  `Vector{Any}`.

### LinearAlgebra matrix dispatch lattice/order parity (Issue #4020)

- `inv` now checks imported/user `LinearAlgebra.inv` methods before choosing
  the retained VM matrix inverse kernel, so `import LinearAlgebra: inv;
  inv(::Array) = ...` matches upstream dispatch for both `inv(A)` and
  `LinearAlgebra.inv(A)`.
- Module-qualified direct builtin routes for `svd`, `qr`, `eigen`, `eigvals`,
  `cholesky`, and `cond` now route through method dispatch when a user method of
  the same arity exists, instead of bypassing the method table and calling the
  Rust kernel directly.
- Added `linalg_direct_builtin_dispatch_first_4020`, verified against upstream
  Julia and direct sjulia, covering imported user methods for `inv`, `svd`,
  `qr`, `eigen`, `eigvals`, `cholesky`, and `cond`.
- Runtime subtype checks now preserve Julia's rank-specific lattice:
  `Matrix{T} <: AbstractMatrix` and `Vector{T} <: AbstractVector`, but not the
  cross-rank `Matrix{T} <: AbstractVector` shortcut that previously let
  matrix-matrix multiplication enter the matrix-vector method.
- `AbstractVector` / `AbstractMatrix` signature names are no longer collapsed
  to `AbstractArray` during JuliaType parsing, and binary runtime candidate
  collection keeps stdlib `AbstractUser` array methods visible.
- `using LinearAlgebra` module functions are compiled between prelude/Base and
  user top-level methods, matching the common Julia source order where user
  `Base.:*` extensions written after `using LinearAlgebra` override same-signature
  stdlib methods.
- Runtime `typeof` for homogeneous struct arrays now preserves the struct name
  (for example `Vector{Complex{Float64}}`) so specialized matrix-vector methods
  can beat generic `AbstractMatrix, AbstractArray` fallbacks.
- Added `linalg_matmul_matrix_matrix_abstract_dispatch_4020`; verified
  `linalg_matmul_vector_dispatch_first_4020`,
  `linalg_nullspace_logdet_adjoint`, and the full `linalg::` fixture category.

### CallDynamic Value::Array allowlist shrink (Issues #3908/#4019)

- Consolidated `CallDynamic` native Array rank/count inspection behind a single
  helper so generator collect non-empty gating and `IteratorSize` fallback share
  one classified `Value::Array` boundary.
- Removed redundant in-file Array construction tests that were covered by the
  upstream-verified generator fixtures and were inflating the allowlist count.
- `scripts/check_value_array_allowlist.sh` now passes again with
  `vm/exec/call_dynamic.rs` at its ceiling of one `Value::Array` match.

### Dynamic array arithmetic boundary shrink (Issues #3908/#4019)

- Centralized `vm/dynamic_ops/mod.rs` Array result construction behind
  `dynamic_array_value`, replacing repeated inline `Value::Array(new_array_ref)`
  construction in dynamic array arithmetic and scalar-array broadcast fallbacks.
- Tightened `scripts/check_value_array_allowlist.sh` for
  `vm/dynamic_ops/mod.rs` from 12 classified `Value::Array` matches to 6,
  locking the smaller transitional boundary while preserving existing VM
  arithmetic behavior.

### Value::Array allowlist tightening for linalg/iteration (Issues #3908/#4020/#4265/#4266)

- Tightened the classified `Value::Array` ceiling for `vm/builtins_linalg.rs`
  from 31 to 2, matching the current LinearAlgebra wrapper boundary after the
  #4020 fallback reduction work.
- Tightened the `vm/type_ops/iteration.rs` ceiling from 33 to 31, matching the
  current Generator/Range iteration boundary after the #4265/#4266 reductions.

### CallFunctionVariable Value::Array allowlist tightening (Issue #3908)

- Tightened the classified `Value::Array` ceiling for
  `vm/exec/call_function_variable.rs` from 2 to 1, matching the current runtime
  callable argument type-projection boundary.
- The remaining match is read-only element-type projection for Array arguments;
  any new Array construction or mutation in this path now trips the VM
  `Value::Array` audit.

### Array builtin construction boundary shrink (Issues #3908/#4018)

- Centralized `vm/builtins_arrays.rs` native Array result pushes behind
  `push_array_value` / `push_array_ref`, replacing scattered
  `Value::Array(new_array_ref(...))` construction in zeros/ones/undef,
  `similar`, `reshape`, `push!`, and `pop!` fallbacks.
- Tightened the `vm/builtins_arrays.rs` `Value::Array` ceiling from 25 to 10,
  so new public Array allocation behavior must be classified instead of growing
  the Rust fast-path surface silently.

### Array map! vararg source dispatch (Issue #4019)

- Added a Pure Julia `map!(f, dest::Array, As::Array...)` entry that follows
  upstream `julia/base/abstractarray.jl`'s `map_n!` contract for supported
  Array sources.
- Six or more Array sources now route through Base dispatch instead of failing
  after the fixed 5-source methods, and source tuples can be splatted into
  `map!`.
- Hot supported arities up to eight sources use fixed direct callback calls;
  wider arities fall back to a generic splat call after collecting per-index
  values.
- Added `array_map_bang_vararg_sources_4019`.

### VM call-frame stack boundary restoration (Issue #4317)

- VM function frames now record the operand stack height at call entry and
  internal returns truncate back to that boundary before pushing the return
  value.
- This prevents temporary array/struct/range values produced inside a callee
  from shifting caller-side constructor fields or broadcast arguments.
- The `length(x::Any)` builtin fallback no longer evaluates its argument twice
  when no user-backed runtime candidates exist, fixing `1 * length(y)` for
  `Any`-typed ranges without leaving the range under the builtin result.
- Native `Value::Range` runtime dispatch now filters out incompatible Pure
  Julia range-struct candidates (`LinRange`, `StepRangeLen`, `OneTo`, `LogRange`)
  before builtin fallback selection.
- Verified representative regressions: the `S4(nothing, +, h(), nothing)`
  shifted-field reproducer now returns `(nothing, +, 7, nothing)`, and
  `collect(1:3) .* collect(4:6)` now materializes the expected `Vector{Int64}`;
  `functions_length_any_range_rhs_4317` covers the nested builtin RHS case.

### CallDynamic Type singleton covariant dispatch parity (Issue #3910)

- Generic `CallDynamic` now encodes runtime `Value::DataType(T)` arguments as
  Julia dispatch singleton types (`Type{T}`) instead of matching them as
  `DataType`.
- Runtime subtype checks now understand `Type{T} <: Type{<:Bound}`, and the
  shared typed resolver no longer lets covariant-bound candidates match as
  unconstrained type variables before the subtype fallback.
- The existing `typed_dispatch_covariant_resolver_3910` fixture now passes
  through the `Any`-typed `CallDynamic` path: `Type{DispatchDog3910}` selects the
  exact method, while `Type{DispatchCat3910}` selects the
  `Type{<:DispatchAnimal3910}` method.

### eltype Vector user-method dispatch fallback parity (Issue #4276)

- `eltype(::Vector{Int64})` user methods now win before sjulia's array
  element-type fallback for both direct calls and `x::Any` runtime calls.
- The direct compile shortcut only uses the builtin array eltype route when the
  method table does not resolve to a user method for the concrete argument
  type.
- The `Any` path emits `CallDynamicOrBuiltin(BuiltinId::Eltype, ...)` with
  non-`Any` eltype candidates, so runtime user methods are tried before the
  retained builtin fallback.

### size Vector user-method dispatch fallback parity (Issue #4276)

- `size(::Vector{Int64})` user methods now win before sjulia's array shape
  fallback for both direct calls and `x::Any` runtime calls.
- The `Any` path uses `CallDynamicOrBuiltin(BuiltinId::Size, ...)` with
  user-backed unary candidates, preserving the builtin fallback for ordinary
  vectors while making upstream-compatible `Base.size` extensions visible.
- Added a dispatch fixture that confirms `Vector{Int64}` uses the user method
  and `Vector{Float64}` still returns the normal `(n,)` shape.

### length/ndims/similar Vector user-method dispatch fallback parity (Issue #4276)

- `length(::Vector{Int64})` and `ndims(::Vector{Int64})` user methods now win
  before sjulia's VM fallback for `x::Any` runtime calls, matching upstream
  dispatch visibility while retaining builtin fallback for ordinary vectors.
- One-argument `similar(x::Any)` now tries user-backed unary `similar`
  candidates before the VM array allocation fallback, so `similar(::Vector)`
  extensions are visible on the Any path used by VM execution.
- Multi-argument `similar(a, dims...)` and `similar(a, T, dims...)` now use
  `CallTypedDispatchOrBuiltin` when user-backed same-arity `similar` methods
  exist, so `Vector{Int64}` extensions win for direct and `x::Any` calls while
  ordinary arrays still fall back to the iOS-safe VM allocation path.
- Added coverage to `dispatch_similar_any_vector_user_method_4276` for direct
  and `Any` runtime dim/typed-dim forms, verified against upstream Julia.

### Array getindex/setindex! user-method dispatch fallback parity (Issue #4276)

- Public `getindex` / `setindex!` calls on primitive `Vector` receivers now
  check user methods before the VM `IndexLoad` / `IndexStore` fallback.
- Bracket reads `a[i]` now route through `getindex(a, i)` when a matching user
  method exists, preserving the fast typed indexing path for ordinary arrays.
- Bracket assignment `a[i] = v` now routes through `setindex!(a, v, i)` when a
  matching user method exists; otherwise it retains the existing direct VM
  mutation path for iOS/no-JIT performance.

### reshape Vector user-method dispatch fallback parity (Issue #4276)

- `reshape(::Vector{Int64}, dims...)` user methods now win before sjulia's VM
  reshape fallback for direct calls and `x::Any` runtime calls, matching
  upstream Julia's public `Base.reshape` dispatch visibility.
- Ordinary arrays without matching user methods still use the retained VM
  reshape fallback for iOS/no-JIT execution.
- Added `dispatch_reshape_user_method_4276`, verified against upstream Julia
  and direct sjulia.

### Dict view user-method dispatch fallback parity (Issue #4276)

- `keys` / `values` / `pairs` user methods on `Dict{K,V}` now win before the
  retained Rust-backed Dict view fallback for direct calls and `x::Any` runtime
  calls.
- `Dict(k => v, ...)` now preserves homogeneous key/value type parameters in
  the VM `Value::Dict` runtime type name, so dispatch sees
  `Dict{String, Float64}` instead of `Dict{Any, Any}` for representative typed
  literals.
- Ordinary Dict values without matching user methods still use the existing VM
  Dict view fallback.
- Added `dispatch_dict_views_user_method_4276`, verified against upstream Julia
  and direct sjulia.

### Dict keytype/valtype user-method dispatch fallback parity (Issue #4276)

- `keytype(::Dict{K,V})` and `valtype(::Dict{K,V})` user methods now win before
  the retained Rust-backed Dict type-parameter fallbacks for direct calls and
  `x::Any` runtime calls.
- Ordinary Dict values without matching user methods now return their preserved
  key/value type parameters instead of `Any` for representative typed literals.
- Added `dispatch_dict_keytype_valtype_user_method_4276`, verified against
  upstream Julia and direct sjulia.

### Dict get! user-method dispatch fallback parity (Issue #4276)

- `get!(::Dict{K,V}, key, default)` user methods now win before the retained
  Rust-backed Dict mutation fallback for direct calls and `x::Any` runtime
  calls.
- Ordinary Dict values without matching user methods still use the existing VM
  `get!` fallback.
- Added `dispatch_dict_getbang_user_method_4276`, verified against upstream
  Julia and direct sjulia.

### Dict empty!/merge! user-method dispatch fallback parity (Issue #4276)

- `empty!(::Dict{K,V})` and `merge!(::Dict{K,V}, ::Dict{K,V})` user methods
  now win before the retained Rust-backed Dict mutation fallbacks for direct
  calls and `x::Any` runtime calls.
- Fallback calls that do not match the user method still store the mutated
  Dict back into the original local, preserving existing VM in-place behavior.
- Added `dispatch_dict_empty_merge_user_method_4276`, verified against upstream
  Julia and direct sjulia.

### Dict delete! user-method dispatch fallback parity (Issue #4276)

- `delete!(::Dict{K,V}, key)` user methods now win before the retained
  Rust-backed Dict delete fallback for direct calls and `x::Any` runtime calls.
- Fallback calls that do not match the user method still store the mutated Dict
  or Set back into the original local, preserving existing VM in-place behavior.
- Added `dispatch_dict_delete_user_method_4276`, verified against upstream
  Julia and direct sjulia.

### Dict pop! user-method dispatch fallback parity (Issue #4276)

- `pop!(::Dict{K,V}, key)` and `pop!(::Dict{K,V}, key, default)` user methods
  now win before the retained Rust-backed Dict pop fallback for direct calls
  and `x::Any` runtime calls.
- Fallback calls that do not match the user method still store the mutated Dict
  back into the original local while returning the popped/default value.
- Added `dispatch_dict_pop_user_method_4276`, verified against upstream Julia
  and direct sjulia.

### Array arithmetic Any-path user-method dispatch fallback parity (Issue #4276)

- `+(a::Vector{Int64}, b::Vector{Int64})` user methods now participate in
  runtime binary dispatch when array operands flow through `Any`-typed
  parameters.
- Lazy-specialized unannotated functions such as `f(a, b) = a + b` now fall
  back to the generic VM body for non-primitive binary operands, so vector user
  methods still win before Rust array arithmetic fallback.
- The VM array arithmetic fallback remains available for ordinary array pairs,
  such as `Vector{Float64} + Vector{Float64}`.

### Callable singleton HOF dispatch fallback parity (Issue #4276)

- Named function values now carry callable singleton dispatch types such as
  `typeof(identity)` and `typeof(+)` instead of being erased to bare
  `Function` during compile-time and VM runtime dispatch.
- The shared CoreType lattice treats these singleton structs as subtypes of
  `Function`, so generic HOF methods still match while more specific
  `map(::typeof(identity), ::Vector)` and
  `broadcast(::typeof(+), ::Vector, ::Vector)` user methods win first.
- Added `dispatch_callable_singleton_hof_user_method_4276` for direct and
  `Any`-typed runtime paths.

### Rank-sensitive Matrix map dispatch fallback parity (Issue #4276)

- `reshape(array, dims...)` now projects its rank into Julia dispatch inference:
  rank 1 becomes `Vector{T}`, rank 2 becomes `Matrix{T}`, and higher ranks use
  `Array{T,N}`.
- Direct `map(::typeof(identity), ::Matrix{Int64})` calls now preserve Matrix
  rank and select the Matrix user method instead of the Vector/generic HOF
  fallback.
- Runtime `Any` Matrix dispatch remains on the existing VM typed-dispatch path,
  so direct/static and runtime paths now agree with upstream Julia for the
  representative `reshape([1,2,3,4], 2, 2)` case.
- Added `dispatch_map_matrix_rank_user_method_4276`.

### Generic unary broadcast materialization parity (Issue #4276)

- Pure Julia `copyto!(dest::Array, bc::Broadcasted)` now materializes the
  broadcast element into a local before storing into typed destination arrays,
  avoiding a VM array-assignment lowering path that treated direct RHS
  broadcast calls as tuple values.
- `broadcast(identity, [1, 2])` and unary user-function broadcasts now match
  upstream by returning typed `Vector{Int64}` results instead of raising
  `expected I64, got "Tuple"`.
- The same local-materialization rule was extended across the Pure Julia
  broadcast pipeline for binary `broadcast(f, A, B)`, `broadcast!`, generic
  `copyto!`, `preprocess`, `similar(::Broadcasted, ::Type)`, 2D fast paths,
  and reshaped shared-storage broadcasts.
- Struct-backed `LinRange` / `StepRangeLen` collection now materializes typed
  vectors directly, allowing range transpose setup for 2D broadcast to proceed
  without the empty `_collect(1:1, ...)` boundary.
- The fused range-grid expression `xs' .+ im .* ys` in
  `broadcast_range_size_2d` now passes through the full `broadcast::` fixture
  category; the staged and fused forms both preserve the expected `(2, 3)`
  complex matrix shape.
- Added `dispatch_broadcast_identity_materialization_4276`.

### Collection mutation user-method dispatch fallback parity (Issue #4276)

- `push!`, `pop!`, `pushfirst!`, `popfirst!`, `insert!`, and `deleteat!` now
  fall through to ordinary method dispatch when a same-arity user method can
  match the call, instead of always taking the primitive VM mutation fallback
  for Array / `Any` receivers.
- Runtime `Any` receiver cases reuse the existing `CallTypedDispatch` path, so
  user `Vector{Int64}` methods can win while ordinary `Vector{Float64}`
  mutation still uses the VM in-place fallback.
- Added `dispatch_collection_mutation_user_method_4276`.

### Integer StepRange collect Base dispatch (Issue #4266)

- Direct integer `StepRange` collection such as `collect(1:2:7)` and
  `collect(5:-1:1)` now enters the sjulia Base `collect(::StepRange{T,S})`
  bridge and `_collect(..., IteratorEltype, IteratorSize)` trait path instead
  of the static `RangeCollect` compatibility boundary.
- User-defined `collect(::StepRange)` / `collect(::AbstractRange)` methods still
  win before the retained runtime fallback.
- Runtime `collect(x::Any)` for integer non-unit `StepRange` now scores the Base
  `collect(::StepRange{T,S})` bridge before the native materialization fallback;
  runtime floating `StepRangeLen` remains on the VM-native boundary until its
  representation can safely support Pure Julia field access.

### Numeric constructor arity MethodError parity (Issue #4316)

- Primitive numeric type constructors used as direct calls or runtime `DataType`
  callables now preserve Julia-compatible arity: `Float64(1, 10)` and
  `T = Float64; T(1, 10)` raise catchable `MethodError` instead of ignoring
  extra positional arguments.
- VM runtime callable fallback now raises through the normal handler path so
  `@test_throws MethodError` also works when the bad constructor call happens
  inside `collect(Base.Generator(...))`.
- Empty tuple-splat Generator collection keeps upstream `_default_eltype`
  behavior for the unsupported constructor case, returning `Vector{Union{}}`
  for `Base.Generator(Float64, Int64[], [10, 20])`.

### LinearAlgebra bounded Matrix dispatch parity (Issue #4020)

- `Matrix{<:Integer}` method signatures now preserve the upper-bound check in
  lowering, CoreType dispatch scoring, MethodTable selection, and VM runtime
  `CallDynamic` fallback.
- `Matrix{Int64}` selects the bounded integer method while `Matrix{Float64}`
  no longer falls through the same-family runtime fallback to that method.
- Added a LinearAlgebra fixture where `det` / `lu` dispatch between
  `Matrix{<:Integer}` and `Matrix{<:AbstractFloat}` methods for both
  unqualified and `LinearAlgebra.`-qualified calls.

## 最新対応 (2026-05-21)

### LinearAlgebra dispatch-first fallback reduction (Issue #4020)

- `det` and `lu` public routes now try method dispatch before the retained Rust
  LinearAlgebra fallback.
- Added upstream-compatible fixtures where user `det(::Array)` / `lu(::Array)`
  methods win before VM fallback for both unqualified calls and
  `LinearAlgebra.det` / `LinearAlgebra.lu`.
- This keeps the fallback available for existing matrix behavior while reducing
  the public Rust boundary for method-extensible LinearAlgebra calls.

### Diagonal `size(D, dim)` VM parity (Issue #4314)

- `size(::Diagonal, ::Int)` now avoids the VM's current `||` condition weakness
  in this Pure Julia stdlib method while preserving the upstream result.
- Added a focused fixture for `size(D, 1)` / `size(D, 2)` and verified the
  existing Diagonal linalg fixture no longer hits a runtime type error.
- Verified the Rust iOS simulator target and the Swift iOS simulator app build.

### callable local callee dispatch (Issue #4313)

- upstream Julia resolves a callee name through lexical scope before global
  method lookup, so `op(x, y)` where `op` is a local binding must call the
  runtime value held by `op`.
- sjulia now routes any local binding used in function position through the
  VM callable-value path. This covers cases where inference narrows the local
  imprecisely, while keeping execution on the no-JIT VM path used by iOS.
- `Expr::FunctionRef` is also typed as `ValueType::Function` during legacy
  local collection so function-valued ternaries do not fall back to integer
  defaults.

### tuple equality numeric parity (Issue #4312)

- Tuple equality now compares elements recursively with Julia-style equality
  instead of using debug-string equality for the whole tuple payload.
- This makes representative HOF results such as `(2, 4, 6) == (2.0, 4.0, 6.0)`
  match upstream Julia while preserving the existing VM equality builtin path.

### `resize!(Vector{Bool})` default preservation (Issue #4311)

- `resize!` growth now pushes branch-specific default values directly instead
  of storing the default in a joined local binding.
- This avoids widening the default to `0.0` before pushing into Bool arrays and
  keeps `resize!(Bool[], n)` compatible with upstream Julia on the VM/iOS path.

### VM direct call/frame fast path (Issue #4303)

- Added a VM-only fast path for direct `Call` / `CallInbounds` instructions when
  the callee index and arity are known and the target has fixed positional
  parameters with no kwargs, varargs, or runtime type-parameter binding.
- The fast path still pushes a normal VM frame and return IP, so return flow,
  try/catch handler cleanup, cancellation checks, recursion behavior, and the
  iOS app's no-JIT VM embedding path remain on the existing interpreter
  architecture.
- The fast path avoids cloning the whole `FunctionInfo`, allocating/reversing an
  argument vector, and cloning scalar argument values before slot binding.
- Added `benchmarks/vm_direct_calls.jl` to isolate repeated small typed direct
  calls. On the `50000`-call workload, sjulia VM median improved from `2.72s` to
  `2.61s`, with `CallDirectFastHit` recording all `50002` fixed direct calls.
- On the small Mandelbrot workload, the same fast path records `9602` hits and
  sjulia VM median measured `2.82s`. Remaining hot cost is still dominated by
  slot loads, arithmetic, branches, and residual dynamic binary dispatch.

### VM dynamic binary primitive fast path (Issue #4306)

- `CallDynamicBinaryBoth` previously recognized that primitive numeric pairs
  should preempt shared resolver dispatch, but still computed type-name strings
  and prepared resolver inputs before falling through to primitive fallback.
- The hot `Float64`/`Float64` and `Int64`/`Int64` pairs now execute directly at
  the top of `execute_binary_both` when the fallback intrinsic is one of the
  supported primitive arithmetic/comparison operations.
- The fast path preserves the existing dispatch policy: only pairs already known
  to preempt the shared resolver are handled; Bool equality and non-primitive
  pairs remain on the resolver/fallback path.
- Profiling now reports dynamic binary events. On the small Mandelbrot workload,
  `BinaryBothPrimitiveFastHit` records `498795` hits, which corresponds to the
  remaining hot `CallDynamicBinaryBoth::MulFloat/14` and
  `CallDynamicBinaryBoth::AddFloat/11` instructions reaching primitive fallback
  without resolver preparation.
- Remaining VM performance work is now dominated by typed local load frequency
  and function-call/frame overhead (#4303), not resolver lookup for these
  primitive binary hot spots.

### VM Any-path return/profiler diagnostics (Issue #4305)

- Return type annotations lower through `convert(T, value)` to match upstream
  Julia semantics. Some convert calls still compile as `Any`, which previously
  forced the function epilogue to use `ReturnAny` even when the declared return
  type was a primitive.
- Function-body return compilation now trusts the declared/inferred primitive
  return boundary for `Any`-typed converted expressions and emits the primitive
  return opcode. The typed return still validates the stack value at runtime,
  so this remains compatible with the no-JIT iOS VM path.
- The profiler now separates `CallDynamicBinaryBoth` by intrinsic and candidate
  count. On the small Mandelbrot benchmark after #4302, the remaining dynamic
  binary hot spots are `CallDynamicBinaryBoth::MulFloat/14` (332530 hits) and
  `CallDynamicBinaryBoth::AddFloat/11` (166265 hits).
- This slice removes one avoidable return-side Any path and documents the
  highest-impact remaining blocker: binary expression compilation is still
  losing enough type information in the Mandelbrot inner loop to emit dynamic
  binary dispatch for some Float64 operations.

### typed VM numeric binary bytecode (Issue #4302)

- Upstream Julia lowers primitive numeric methods such as `+(::Int64,::Int64)`
  through intrinsics like `add_int`, but those execute as unboxed primitive ops
  after code generation. sjulia VM previously kept the same semantics through
  `CallIntrinsic`, which added a dispatch branch to every hot primitive
  arithmetic/comparison instruction.
- The compiler now maps proven `Int64` / `Float64` primitive intrinsics to the
  VM's existing typed bytecode. This keeps the no-JIT iOS VM path intact while
  avoiding the generic intrinsic executor for scalar hot loops.
- Integer `+` / `-` / `*` direct and fused VM instructions now use wrapping
  arithmetic, matching Julia's `add_int` / `sub_int` / `mul_int` semantics.
- The VM profiler labels remaining intrinsic calls as
  `CallIntrinsic::<Intrinsic>`, so future work can separate unavoidable
  semantic intrinsics from missed typed-bytecode opportunities.
- On `benchmarks/vm_mandelbrot.jl` (`120x80x60`), `CallIntrinsic` no longer
  appears in the top 20 instructions. Remaining hot spots are typed local slot
  loads, `CallDynamicBinaryBoth`, branches, generic stores, and call overhead.

### typed VM local slot load/store fast paths (Issue #4304)

- The VM already used `vm/slot.rs` to rewrite local name-based load/store
  instructions to slot-indexed locals, but inferred `Int64`, `Float64`, and
  `Bool` locals were still executed through generic `LoadSlot` / `StoreSlot`
  after slotization.
- Slotization now preserves typed local access for `Int64`, `Float64`, and
  `Bool` through dedicated typed slot instructions, avoiding generic store
  conversion and generic value pop paths for those representative hot locals.
- `benchmarks/vm_local_slots.jl` isolates local slot pressure. On the small
  local-slot benchmark, `StoreSlot` fell to setup-only noise while hot access
  appears as `LoadSlotI64`, `StoreSlotI64`, `LoadSlotF64`, `StoreSlotF64`,
  `LoadSlotBool`, and `StoreSlotBool`.
- Mandelbrot still shows major remaining cost in typed local loads plus dynamic
  binary dispatch, generic stores, and call/frame overhead, so the next
  performance issues remain #4303, #4305, and #4306 rather than more
  name-to-slot work.

### iOS REPL plotSVG initializer build fix (Issue #4307)

- `REPLEvalResult` includes an optional `plotSVG` field for plot display
  artifacts, but two early-return error paths in `REPLSessionManager` still
  used the older initializer shape and blocked the iOS simulator app build.
- The non-plot error paths now pass `plotSVG: nil`, restoring the SwiftUI app
  build while preserving the VM/iOS embedding path required for VM performance
  work.

### `Tuple{}` type-object equality parity (Issue #4300)

- upstream Julia distinguishes bare `Tuple` from concrete empty tuple type
  `Tuple{}`: `Tuple == Tuple{}` is false, while `typeof(()) == Tuple{}` is true.
- sjulia previously parsed `Tuple{}` as bare `Tuple`, so `typeof(())` displayed
  as `Tuple{}` but failed equality and identity checks against the `Tuple{}`
  type object.
- `JuliaType::from_name("Tuple{}")` now returns `TupleOf([])`, preserving empty
  tuple type identity and making `typeof(f(Val{()}())) == Tuple{}` pass in the
  #4268 value-parameter fixture.

### Keyword default expression preservation (Issue #4297)

- upstream Julia preserves quoted Symbol keyword defaults such as
  `debuginfo=:default` as `Symbol` values when the keyword is omitted, and accepts
  explicit overrides like `debuginfo=:none`.
- sjulia lowered simple quoted symbols to `QuoteLiteral(SymbolNew(...))`, but
  kwarg default evaluation/type inference only handled `Expr::Literal`; omitted
  defaults therefore fell back to `Int64(0)` and explicit Symbol overrides could
  trip an `I64` slot expectation.
- kwarg default evaluation now recognizes simple quoted-symbol constructors as
  `Value::Symbol`, stores Bool defaults as `Value::Bool`, and records
  `ValueType::Symbol` / `ValueType::Bool` for these defaults.
- omitted non-literal keyword defaults now retain their IR expression and the VM
  evaluates supported default expressions left-to-right, so `x=1+2` and later
  defaults like `b=a+1` see earlier omitted or explicit keyword values.
- default expressions that reference global bindings now read the call-time
  global value, preserving cases like `debuginfo=x4297` and later rebinding.
- `kwargs_symbol_default_4297` fixes omitted and explicit Symbol keyword
  defaults against upstream behavior, including the preceding `generated=true`
  Bool default in the representative reflection shape.
- `kwargs_default_expression_order_4297` fixes arithmetic default expressions,
  left-to-right dependency ordering, and call-time global default lookup against
  upstream behavior.
- the same fixture now covers simple zero-argument calls in defaults, including
  `x=default_num()+1` and `debuginfo=default_sym()`, while keeping broader
  arbitrary-call keyword wrapper parity listed as remaining scope.
- abstract inference now seeds keyword parameter locals from supported defaults
  left-to-right, so `Base.infer_return_type(f, Tuple{})` preserves `Int64` /
  `Symbol` for simple default-call wrappers that upstream Julia infers.
- the bounded default evaluator now also supports simple positional-argument
  calls with literal / already-bound default-expression arguments, covering
  `x=default_arg(41)` and `debuginfo=identity_sym(:default)` representative cases.
- the same evaluator now supports simple keyword calls in keyword defaults, so
  `x=default_kw(x=41)`, dependent forms such as `x=default_kw(x=seed)`, and
  Symbol-preserving keyword calls follow upstream omitted-default behavior.

### Mutable array index guard inference parity (Issue #4270)

- upstream Julia does not treat repeated `a[1]` reads from a mutable
  `Vector{Union{T,Nothing}}` as `MustAlias`; the guard `a[1] !== nothing ? a[1] : 0`
  therefore preserves the element union rather than narrowing the second read.
- sjulia had two precision gaps: indexed loads participated in path-based
  conditional narrowing, and reflection-time conversion of
  `Vector{Union{Int64,Nothing}}` widened `Nothing` to `Any`.
- indexed conditional narrowing is now field-path-only, array `getindex` transfer
  preserves `Union` element types, and reflection specialization preserves
  `Nothing` inside union array elements.
- `type_inference_index_guard_mutable_array_4270` fixes the upstream-compatible
  result: `Base.infer_return_type` and `Core.Compiler.return_type` both return
  `Union{Nothing,Int64}` while runtime calls still return `1` / `0`.

### Method-world inference cache invalidation (Issue #4271)

- upstream Julia は `MethodInstance` / `CodeInstance` の valid world range と
  backedge invalidation で、method 追加・置換後に古い推論結果を再利用しない。
- sjulia はまだ full world-age / backedge graph を持たないため、最初の互換 slice として
  inference-only method table mutation ごとに conservative single-world counter を進め、
  return type cache / PartialStruct return cache / tentative recursive results / limited-accuracy
  markers を全て破棄するようにした。
- `test_issue_4271_method_replacement_invalidates_return_cache` で、同じ signature の method
  replacement 後に stale return cache が残らず world counter が進むことを固定した。
- 残りは precise `MethodInstanceKey`、dependency backedges、valid world range、compile ordering
  と runtime redefinition の完全互換である。

### CallMeta numeric exception/effect parity (Issue #4274)

- upstream Julia は `CallMeta(rt, exct, effects, ...)` で return type と例外型 /
  effects を同時に運ぶ。`div` / `rem` / `mod` / `%` の整数引数は effect-free だが
  `nothrow=false` / `DivideError`、Float が混ざる数値引数は `nothrow=true` /
  `Union{}` と扱われる。
- sjulia の effect inference はこれらを名前ベースの pure arithmetic として扱っており、
  整数除算系の例外情報が `ExceptionType::Bottom` に落ちていた。
- `Effects::effect_free_may_throw` を追加し、`infer_expr_result` は call / binary op の
  引数 lattice type を見て整数除算系だけ `DivideError`、Float 数値経路は `Bottom` に
  refine する。
- 既存 `test_issue_3714_inferred_expr_tracks_call_exception_effects` と effect inference unit で
  `div(::Int64,::Int64)` / `div(::Float64,::Float64)` / binary `%` の effect boundary を固定した。

### Array `!=` dispatch fallback parity (Issue #4276)

- upstream Julia は `!=(x, y) = !(x == y)` を generic operator として定義しているため、
  user-defined `Base.:(==)(::Vector{T}, ::Vector{T})` は explicit `!=` method がなくても
  `a != b` に反映される。
- sjulia の array/memory comparison fallback は `BinaryOp::Ne` を直接 `BuiltinId::Isequal`
  + `NotBool` に落としていたため、`==` の user method を迂回していた。
- array/memory の `!=` fallback は明示的に `==` を compile してから `NotBool` するようにし、
  `==` 側の method dispatch / user override / builtin fallback を共有する。
- `dispatch_array_ne_uses_user_eq_4276` で、user-defined vector `==` が `!=` にも効くことを
  本家 Julia と sjulia の双方で固定した。
- follow-up で `BASE_FUNCTION_ROUTES` の public fallback inventory を
  `docs/vm/PUBLIC_FALLBACKS.md` に文書化し、`scripts/check_base_routing_registry.sh` が
  code/doc の route 名同期も検査するようにした。

### String/Symbol/Bool/Char/Type{T} equality dispatch fallback parity (Issue #4298)

- upstream Julia は `Base.:(==)(::String, ::String)` /
  `Base.:(==)(::Symbol, ::Symbol)` / `Base.:(==)(::Bool, ::Bool)` /
  `Base.:(==)(::Char, ::Char)` / `Base.:(==)(::Type{T}, ::Type{T})` の
  user-defined method を direct call と `Any`
  runtime dispatch の両方で選び、`!=` は generic `!(==)` 経由で同じ override を反映する。
- sjulia の String `EqStr` fallback、Symbol/Char singleton identity fallback、Bool primitive
  fallback、DataType equality fallback、および `CallDynamicBinaryBoth` candidate filter がこれらの equality method を
  迂回していた。
- dispatch-first equality target を String/Symbol/Bool/Char/Type{T} に広げ、該当 equality methods を
  runtime binary dispatch candidates に含めた。Bool/Bool の `Any` runtime equality は exact
  `==(::Bool, ::Bool)` candidate がある場合だけ primitive fallback より resolver を優先する。
- `Any` runtime dispatch では `Value::DataType(T)` を binary dispatch 用に `Type{T}` として
  resolver へ渡し、exact `==(::Type{T}, ::Type{T})` を DataType fallback より先に選ぶ。
- `!=` は dispatch-first equality candidate がある場合に `==` を compile して `NotBool` する。
- `dispatch_string_symbol_eq_user_method_4298` で direct String/Symbol/Bool/Char/Type{Int64} と `Any`
  wrapper の `==` / `!=` が本家と一致することを固定した。

### AoT const-aware specialization keys (Issue #4272)

- compile-side inference は `InferenceCacheKey` で Bool / Symbol / Nothing / small Int const を
  key に残すが、AoT の `CodeInstanceKey` は ABI 用 `Vec<StaticType>` だけで dedup していたため、
  `f(true)` と `f(false)` が同じ specialization identity になっていた。
- `CodeInstanceKey` に ABI/codegen 用 `arg_types` とは別に `arg_key` を追加し、
  direct user-function call site では literal Bool / Nothing / Symbol / small Int を
  const-aware key として保持するようにした。
- const-aware key で enqueue 済みの `CodeInstance` にも final inference result が attach
  されるようにし、同じ ABI tuple を持つ true/false specialization が未推論のまま残らないようにした。
- `aot::specialization::tests::issue_4272_const_bool_arg_keys_remain_distinct` で
  `Bool` の true/false call-site key が同一 `StaticType::Bool` でも別 specialization になることを固定し、
  `issue_4272_attach_inference_updates_const_specializations` で両方に inference result が付くことを確認した。

### PartialStruct return field inference (Issue #4269)

- upstream Julia は immutable default constructor の戻り値を `Core.PartialStruct` 相当で扱い、
  `getfield(make_box(flag), :b)` のように関数 return を跨いだ field access でも
  constructor argument 由来の field value type を保持する。
- sjulia は local binding `box = PairBox4269(...); getfield(box, :b)` では String を
  保持していたが、`make_box4269(flag) = PairBox4269(..., "x")` を呼ぶ形では
  function return cache が struct type だけを持ち、field precision が `Any` に落ちていた。
- abstract inference に PartialStruct-style return fact cache を追加し、default immutable
  constructor 由来の field facts を one-call interprocedural path へ渡すようにした。
- `type_inference_partial_struct_return_field_4269` で direct call / local assignment /
  direct local constructor の runtime と `Base.return_types` / `Base.infer_return_type` が
  本家同様 `String` になることを固定した。

### raw comparison-aware joins before limit_type_size (Issue #4273)

- upstream Julia の `limit_type_size(t, compare=...)` は、比較元にすでに含まれる
  complexity を新規 growth として数えず、既知の wide union を idempotent に扱う。
- sjulia の `join_limited` は public `join` を先に呼んでいたため、`compare_to` があるのに
  その前段で `simplify_union` が `Top` / numeric abstract type へ widening してしまい、
  `limit_type_size` が precision を回復できなかった。
- `join_raw` を追加し、public `join` は従来通り bounded path として残しつつ、
  `join_limited` / `widen_conditional` / env merge は pre-widen しない raw join から
  comparison-aware limit を適用するようにした。
- `type_inference_raw_join_limit_type_size_4273` で本家同様、9-member mixed wide union の
  `flag ? x : x` が `Any` ではなく元の union type を保持することを固定した。

### zip5/zip6/zip7 collected tuple eltype parity (Issue #4281)

- upstream Julia は `collect(zip(...6/7 iterators...))` の result type だけでなく、
  `eltype(result)` も `Tuple{T1,...}` の canonical tuple type を返す。
- sjulia は `typeof(result)` と `typeof(result[1])` は `Tuple{Int64,Float64,Int8,Bool,String,Char}`
  を保持していたが、`eltype(result)` が display-only `Struct("Tuple{...}")` projection を
  返していたため、literal `Tuple{...}` との型比較で不一致になっていた。
- `Zip5` / `Zip6` / `Zip7` を既存の `Zip` / `Zip3` / `Zip4` と同じ native collect / iterator
  recognition path に追加し、`ArrayElementType::TupleOf` の `eltype` projection は
  `JuliaType::TupleOf` を返すようにした。
- `iteration_zip_nary` の zip6 / zip7 collect check は本家同様 `eltype(result)` と
  `typeof(result[1])` が canonical tuple type として一致する。

### union type-object equality for reflection return joins (Issue #4287)

- upstream Julia では `Union{Int64,String}` と `Union{String,Int64}` は同一の型として
  比較されるため、`Base.infer_return_type` が union member order を変えて返しても
  `==` / `===` / `isequal` は通る。
- sjulia の `DataType` 比較は `JuliaType::Union(Vec<_>)` の格納順に依存していたため、
  `Base.return_types(...)[1] == Union{Int64,String}` は通る一方で、
  `_type_union` を経由する `Base.infer_return_type(...) == Union{Int64,String}` が
  representative #4287 fixture で落ちていた。
- `JuliaType::type_eq` を追加し、`Union` member を順序非依存で比較するようにした。
  VM の `DataType` `==` / `!=`、`===`、`isequal`、struct field identity path はこの
  Julia-compatible type equality を使う。
- `reflection_return_types_union_split_4287` は本家 Julia と sjulia の双方で
  `Base.return_types` / `Base.infer_return_type` が通ることを固定した。

### type-stability diagnostic parity fixtures (Issue #4291)

- #4291 の acceptance criteria に合わせ、diagnostic report と実際の return-type behavior を
  同じ source で比較する代表ケースを追加した。
- `type_stability_diagnostic_parity_4291` は arrays, tuples, generators,
  local closure inside generator, dispatch caller の `Base.infer_return_type` と runtime
  behavior を固定する。
- `api::type_stability_report_matches_return_type_fixture_shapes_4291` は同じ source を
  `compile_and_run_value` で通したあと、`analyze_type_stability` の report が
  `Array{Int64}` / `Tuple{Int64,Float64}` / `Int64` stable と一致することを確認する。
- public API / CLI report path は production shared inference snapshot を使うようになり、
  report provenance も `uses_production_inference: true` を返す。standalone analyzer は
  diagnostic notes / fallback path として残している。
- CLI `--type-stability --json` は report 対象外の Base/prelude 全関数を eager 推論せず、
  user/report 対象の production facts だけを二段で収集する。これにより
  `plain_4291() = 41` の function-only file が timeout せず stable report を返す。
- type-stability production facts が user struct table を使うようにし、default constructor
  return が `Top` に落ちた場合は `Struct{name}` snapshot を回復する。これにより
  `make_box() = TSBox(41); field_from_box() = make_box().x` の代表ケースも stable report になる。
- non-parametric inner constructor methods are now seeded into the production
  report inference engine, so `TSBoxInner(x) = new(x + 1)` and
  `field_inner() = make_inner().x` no longer report `Top` / unstable in
  type-stability JSON/API reports.
- 残りは statement-level typed IR、effects、cache invalidation、world-age metadata を
  diagnostic report に接続すること。

### `getfield(obj, :field)` union field inference (Issue #4270)

- lowering 後の `:value` は synthetic `Literal::Symbol` ではなく
  `QuoteLiteral(SymbolNew("value"))` として IR に現れるため、abstract inference の
  static field-name extraction がこの形も扱うようにした。
- `field_get_4270(x::Box4270) = getfield(x, :value)` で
  `Box4270.value::Union{Int64,Nothing}` が本家同様 `Union{Nothing, Int64}` と推論される。
- broader MustAlias / SSA-versioned alias identity はまだ #4270 の残り範囲。

### non-const global reader reflection avoids stale precision (Issue #4285)

- upstream Julia は non-const global reader を `Any` として扱い、単一代入・関数定義後の
  初回代入・後続の incompatible rebinding のいずれでも stale concrete inference を返さない。
- `type_inference_global_binding_invalidation_4285` に
  single / late / rebound non-const global reader の
  `Base.infer_return_type(..., Tuple{}) === Any` と
  `Base.return_types(...)[1] === Any` を追加し、sjulia も同じ conservative result を固定した。
- full binding dependency graph / world-age-aware invalidation は #4285 の残り範囲。

### VM-native range collect user-method dispatch (Issue #4266)

- upstream Julia は `collect(r::UnitRange{Int64})`、
  `collect(r::StepRange{Int64,Int64})`、`collect(r::AbstractRange)` のような
  user-defined method を `collect(1:3)` / `collect(1:2:7)` / float range collect と
  `collect(x::Any)` runtime path の両方で Base range materialization より優先する。
- sjulia の static / runtime VM-native `Value::Range` collect boundary を狭め、user-defined
  range collect candidate がある場合は `RangeCollect` pre-score fallback より先に dispatch
  scoring へ渡すようにした。
- `iteration_range_collect_user_method_4266` と
  `iteration_steprange_collect_user_method_4266`、
  `iteration_abstractrange_collect_user_method_4266` を追加し、通常の
  `collect(1:3)::Vector{Int64}` fallback は維持した。
- 2026-05-21 slice: upstream `./julia/base/range.jl` の
  `collect(r::AbstractRange) = Array(r)` を参照し、user range method が存在しない
  direct integer `UnitRange` (`collect(1:3)`) は sjulia Base の
  `collect(::UnitRange{T})` bridge から `_collect(..., IteratorEltype, IteratorSize)`
  trait path へ入るようにした。user override のない `StepRange` は iOS/no-JIT safe な
  runtime VM boundary に残す。
- `iteration_unitrange_collect_base_dispatch_4266` と compile bytecode regression を追加し、
  direct `UnitRange` が static `RangeCollect` ではなく Base dispatch へ入ること、
  direct integer `StepRange` も static `RangeCollect` ではなく Base dispatch へ入ることを
  固定した。
  2026-05-22 follow-up では user `collect(::AbstractRange)` がある時に sjulia-internal
  range collect bridges を candidate から外し、本家同様 user abstract method を優先する。
  同日 follow-up で direct integer `StepRange` (`collect(1:2:7)` / `collect(5:-1:1)`)
  も sjulia Base の `collect(::StepRange{T,S})` bridge から `_collect` trait path へ入る。
- 2026-05-22 follow-up: direct numeric floating ranges such as
  `collect(1.0:0.5:2.0)` now also fall through to the Base range collect bridge
  instead of the static `RangeCollect` boundary, while preserving
  `Vector{Float64}`. The same bridge preserves `Vector{Int64}` for VM-native
  integer `StepRange` values whose indexing currently yields Float64.
- 2026-05-22 follow-up: runtime `collect(x::Any)` for integer non-unit
  `StepRange` now includes the Base `StepRange` collect method in dynamic
  candidate scoring, so it avoids the pre-score range materialization fallback
  while preserving `Vector{Int64}`. Runtime floating `StepRangeLen` is still
  intentionally kept on the native fallback because the VM-native range is not a
  Pure Julia struct and `collect(::StepRangeLen)` reads fields.
- full trait-shaped representation replacement for VM-native ranges / final
  native carrier removal は #4568 へ渡す。

### VM-native Base.Generator collect user-method dispatch (Issue #4265)

- upstream Julia は `collect(g::Base.Generator)` のような user-defined method を
  direct `collect(Base.Generator(...))` と `collect(x::Any)` runtime path の両方で
  `Base.collect(itr::Generator)` materialization より優先する。
- sjulia の static / runtime VM-native `Value::Generator` collect boundary を狭め、
  user-defined generator collect candidate がある場合は `collect_generator` pre-score
  fallback より先に dispatch scoring へ渡すようにした。
- `generator_collect_user_method_4265` を追加し、通常の
  `collect(Base.Generator(f, xs))::Vector` fallback は維持した。
- same-day follow-up で `IteratorSize(typeof(g))` / `IteratorEltype(typeof(g))`
  の type-object trait 代表ケースを本家 `julia/base/generator.jl` に合わせた。
  `typeof(Base.Generator(f, xs))` は named function callable を `typeof(f)` として
  保持し、明示 `Tuple{Base.Generator{I, typeof(f)}}` 形の
  `Base.infer_return_type(collect, ...)` は callable body から collected element type
  を推論する。
- same-day follow-up で `Tuple{typeof(g)}` の context-aware 型式 lowering も
  dynamic type construction に通し、`Base.infer_return_type(collect, Tuple{typeof(g)})`
  が代表ケースで `Vector{Int64}` / `Vector{Float64}` を返すようにした。
- 同じく `T = typeof(g); Tuple{T}` のような local DataType alias も型式内で
  runtime DataType value として評価し、`Tuple{T}` collect inference を本家に合わせた。
- 2026-05-21 follow-up で user generator method が存在しない direct
  `collect(Base.Generator(...))` は static `RangeCollect` 直行ではなく、
  collect method table の `CallDynamic` sentinel を通るようにした。Pure Julia
  `iterate(g::Generator)` はまだ VM-native `Value::Generator` の field access を直接扱えないため、
  実行時 materialization は iOS/no-JIT safe な `collect_generator` boundary に戻す。
- same-day follow-up で VM-native `Value::Generator` の `f` / `iter` field projection を
  `g.f`, `g.iter`, `getfield(g, :f/:iter)`, `getfield(g, 1/2)` に追加した。
  `generator_base_generator_field_collect_4265` で本家 `julia/base/generator.jl`
  の field shape を確認し、明示 `Base._collect(1:1, g, IteratorEltype(g),
  IteratorSize(g))` が代表的な non-splat callable generator で `Vector{Int64}` を返すことを
  固定した。公開 `collect(g)` は既存 `collect_similar(::Memory, ::Generator)` と
  tuple-splat/filtered generator の iOS-safe behavior を壊さないよう、まだ VM boundary に残す。
- 2026-05-22 follow-up で nonempty かつ Vector/Memory/Range-backed、lowercase named
  function callable の VM-native generator は runtime public collect sentinel から generic
  `collect(::Any)` / `_collect` method body へ入るようにした。empty/type-constructor/
  tuple-backed/tuple-splat/filtered/eager は default eltype と iOS/no-JIT safety のため
  native `collect_generator` boundary に残す。
- 2026-05-22 follow-up で同じ generic collect gate を nonempty Matrix-backed
  generator に広げ、`collect(Base.Generator(f, [1 2; 3 4]))` と runtime
  `collect(x::Any)` が shape-preserving `_collect(..., ::HasShape)` path に入れるようにした。
  numeric type constructor vararg arity の既存バグは #4316 に分離した。
- 残りは full trait-shaped `Base.collect(itr::Generator)` / `_collect` integration を
  さらに Pure Julia method dispatch へ寄せる範囲。

### while-loop exit narrowing for loop-carried state (Issue #4267)

- upstream Julia の CFG/worklist inference は `while x isa Int64; x = "s"; end` の通常終了で
  condition false 側を反映し、戻り型を `String` と推論する。
- sjulia の legacy block walker は loop body の `String` assignment と pre-loop `Int64` を
  join した `Union{Int64,String}` を post-loop に残していた。
- while fixpoint 後の env と exit false-branch env を `meet` するようにし、
  loop-carried assignment が condition を false にする代表ケースで `String` を保持する。
- `type_inference_while_exit_narrowing_4267` を追加し、runtime /
  `Base.infer_return_type` / `Base.return_types` を本家と比較した。
- production inference path の full CFG/worklist replacement は #4267 の残り範囲。

### representative CodeInfo objects for reflection APIs (Issue #4288)

- upstream `Base.code_lowered(f, Tuple{...})[1]` と `Base.code_typed(...)[1][1]` は
  `Core.CodeInfo` を返し、sjulia の `nothing` placeholder は user-facing reflection として弱かった。
- sjulia は full `Core.CodeInfo` materialization ではないが、matched `Method` と return snapshot
  を持つ `CodeInfo` record を返すようにした。
- 代表 `CodeInfo` record に `.code` field を追加し、本家 `Core.CodeInfo.code` と同じく
  user-facing property access ができるようにした。
- `.code` は空 placeholder ではなく代表 call/return `Expr` vector を返すため、
  `length(code) > 0` と `Expr` element inspection は本家と同じ fixture で固定できる。
  ただし現時点では full lowered/typed SSA IR ではない。
- `Base.code_typed(f, types)[i]` は `Pair(CodeInfo(...), rettype)` を返すため、
  本家同様 `typed[i][1] !== nothing` かつ `typed[i][2]` が inferred return type になる。
- upstream `julia/base/reflection.jl` では `code_typed(...; optimize=false)` と
  `code_typed(...; debuginfo=:source/:none)` は accepted keyword surface で、
  `generated=false` はこの API では受けない。sjulia も代表ケースで
  `optimize` / `debuginfo` を通し、unsupported `generated` は reject するようにした。
- `code_lowered` / `code_typed` now normalize `debuginfo=:default` to `:source`
  and reject unsupported debug levels with the same `ArgumentError` boundary as
  upstream: `"'debuginfo' must be either :source or :none"`.

### unparameterized Array/Vector eltype reflection parity (Issue #4299)

- upstream Julia reports `Any` for unparameterized array type objects such as
  `eltype(Array)` and `eltype(Vector)`, while preserving bound element types for
  `eltype(Vector{Int64})` and `eltype(Matrix{Bool})`.
- sjulia could route `eltype(Vector)` through the parametric `Vector{T}` method
  with an unbound type parameter and raise `UndefVarError`.
- exact `eltype(::Type{Array})` and `eltype(::Type{Vector})` methods now catch
  the unparameterized type-object cases before the parametric methods, matching
  upstream behavior and keeping bound parametric cases unchanged.

### reflection world keyword compatibility for typed code (Issue #4290)

- upstream Julia では `Base.code_typed(f, Tuple{T}; world=w)` は accepted world-aware
  reflection surface で、`Base.code_lowered(f, Tuple{T}; world=w)` は MethodError になる。
- sjulia の single-world model では `code_typed(...; world=w)` を既存 typed snapshot に通し、
  `code_lowered(...; world=w)` は未知 keyword として明示 reject するようにした。
- `hasmethod(f, Tuple{T}; world=Base.get_world_counter())` は current world の method table を
  使い、`world=typemax(UInt64)` は本家代表ケースと同じく `false` を返す。
- `hasmethod(f, Tuple{}, (:kw,); world=typemax(UInt64))` は本家代表ケースと同じ
  generated-function reflection error を返す。
- `reflection_invokelatest_basic_4290` にこの差を追加し、world reflection compatibility の
  supported/rejected boundary を fixture で固定した。

## 最新対応 (2026-05-20)

### user-struct branch narrowing through local aliases (Issue #4270)

- conditional narrowing が `x isa UserStruct` の右辺 user-defined struct 名を
  engine の struct table で解決し、`Union{A,B}` から concrete `A` へ branch-local に
  meet できるようにした。
- `if x isa A; y = x; y.n; end` のような local alias を経由する field access でも、
  alias binding が narrowed struct type を受け取るため field type を `Any` へ落とさない。
- `Base.infer_return_type(narrowed_alias_field_4270, Tuple{Union{A4270,B4270}})` と
  `Core.Compiler.return_type(...)` が upstream 同様 `Int64` を返すことを fixture で固定した。

### tfunc metadata completion and `abs_float` reflection (Issue #4275)

- upstream `julia/Compiler/src/tfuncs.jl` の `add_tfunc(f, minarg, maxarg, tfunc, cost)`
  形状を確認し、sjulia の production tfunc 登録を legacy `register(name, fn)` から
  明示 arity/cost 付き登録へ移した。
- `register_all` 後に metadata-free legacy rule が残っていないことをユニットテストで監査する。
- upstream が `abs(::Float64)` を `abs_float` intrinsic 経由で `Float64` 推論する代表ケースに合わせ、
  `abs_float` / `Core.Intrinsics.abs_float` を tfunc registry に追加した。
- `Base.return_types(abs, Tuple{Float64})` / `Base.infer_return_type(abs, Tuple{Float64})` /
  `Core.Compiler.return_type(abs, Tuple{Float64})` が `Float64` を返すことを fixture で固定した。

### union-split method return joins (Issue #4287)

- upstream `julia/Compiler/src/types.jl` / `abstractinterpretation.jl` の
  `InferenceParams.max_union_splitting == 4` と method match union splitting を確認した。
- sjulia の method-table call inference で lattice union length budget (`8`) を流用せず、
  ordinary method dispatch の union-split expansion budget を `4` に分離した。
- shared `InferenceEngine` に compile loop で構築した method signatures を同期し、
  ternary expression inference で branch type を join するようにし、
  `f(::Int64) -> Int64`, `f(::String) -> String`,
  `g(::Bool) = f(b ? 1 : "x")` の `Base.return_types(g, (Bool,))` が
  `Union{Int64,String}` を返すようにした。
- `FunctionInfo` に precision-preserving `return_julia_type` を追加し、VM reflection の
  `Method.return_type` が `ValueType::Any` へ潰れた union return を復元できるようにした。
- budget 超過時は `UnionSplitTooLarge` diagnostic を出し、巨大 union の method combination
  explosion は Julia と同じく精密列挙へ進まない。

### string array literal type preservation (Issue #4277)

- upstream `./julia/base/array.jl` の array literal type inference と本家実行結果
  `typeof(["a", "b"]) == Vector{String}` / `typeof(['a', 'b']) == Vector{Char}` を確認した。
- sjulia の共有 array literal element inference に homogeneous `String` / `Char` branch を追加し、
  codegen でも typed `ArrayElementType::String` / `Char` storage を使うようにした。
- upstream lowering と同じ `getindex(::Type{T}, vals...)` 代表経路を compiler 側で typed
  vector constructor として扱い、`String["a", "b"]` / `Char['x', 'y']` /
  `Int8[1, 2]` / `Any["a", 1]` と明示 `getindex(String, "a", "b")` を保持するようにした。
- `["a", "b", "c"]`、`String["a", "b"]`、`['a', 'b']`、`Char['x', 'y']`、
  `Int8[1,2]`、`Any["a",1]` の `typeof` / `eltype` / 値保持を fixture で固定した。

### string array transformation type preservation (Issue #4278)

- upstream 実行結果で `similar(["a","b"], 2)`, `repeat(["a","b"], 2)`,
  `repeat(["a" "b"; "c" "d"], 2, 1)`, `permutedims(["a","b"])`,
  `permutedims(["a" "b"; "c" "d"])` が
  `Vector{String}` / `Matrix{String}` を保持することを確認した。
- #4277 の literal typing に加え、`repeat` / `permutedims` の fallback path が
  Any-typed string arrays を受けても `String[]` / `Array{String}` allocation に寄せる代表ケースを追加した。
- `array_string_array_type_preservation_4278` で `similar`, vector/matrix repeat と
  1D/2D permutedims を固定した。既存 `permutedims_type_preservation` の古い
  `Matrix{Any}` 前提も `Matrix{String}` assertion へ更新した。

### heterogeneous generator collect typejoin (Issue #4279)

- upstream `collect(x for x in (1, 2.0))`、
  `collect(x for x in (1, 2.0, Int8(3)))`、
  `collect(x for x in (1, "a"))`、および
  `collect(i == 1 ? 1 : 2.0 for i in 1:2)` の typejoin 結果を確認した。
- comprehension/generator collect codegen で heterogeneous numeric tuple iteration と ternary body の
  result element type を `Real` へ typejoin し、`Vector{Float64}` へ狭まりすぎないようにした。
- non-numeric heterogeneous tuple iteration は `Vector{Any}` へ widening し、`DynamicToF64`
  fallback error に落ちないようにした。
- `generator_heterogeneous_collect_typejoin_4279` を追加した。

### invoke and invokelatest compatibility (Issue #4290)

- upstream `Base.invokelatest(f, args...)` は world age を最新にして呼び出す runtime primitive surface である。
- sjulia は現時点で world-age separated method table を持たないため、ordinary call wrapper として
  `invokelatest(f, args...; kwargs...) = f(args...; kwargs...)` で提供する。
- function-variable call に keyword / positional splat を渡す VM instruction を追加し、
  `Base.invokelatest(f; x=4)` と `Base.invokelatest(f, 3; y=5)` も本家代表ケースに合わせた。
- `Core.invokelatest(f, args...)` も `Base.invokelatest` と同じ supported primitive lookup に接続し、
  `Core.invokelatest(+, 1, 2)` が本家同様 `3` を返す。
- upstream `invoke(f, Tuple{...}, args...)` は通常 dispatch ではなく指定 signature の method を呼ぶ。
  sjulia は compile-time に見える `Tuple{...}` 代表ケースで method table dispatch を指定型に対して行い、
  `invoke(f, Tuple{Number}, 2)` が `Integer` method ではなく `Number` method を呼ぶようにした。
- `Core.invoke(f, Tuple{...}, args...)` も同じ static invoke path へ接続した。
- `Tuple{Vararg{T}}` の末尾 vararg signature を実引数数へ展開し、
  `invoke(f, Tuple{Vararg{Int64}}, 1, 2, 3)` が本家同様指定 signature で dispatch する。
- `invokelatest` positional/vararg/keyword/positional+keyword と、`invoke` / `Base.invoke`
  の 1 引数・2 引数 signature-selected dispatch を fixture で固定した。
- simple `@invoke f(x::T, ...)` expression/statement macro form を
  `invoke(f, Tuple{T, ...}, x, ...)` 相当に lowering し、既存 static `invoke`
  dispatch 経路で本家代表ケースを通すようにした。
- `g = f` のような静的 function alias を compiler が保持し、
  `invoke(g, Tuple{Number}, 2)` でも元の method table を指定 signature で選ぶようにした。
- `sig = Tuple{Number}` のような静的 DataType value alias も保持し、
  `invoke(f, sig, 2)` を本家代表ケースと同じ method selection にした。
- `@invokelatest f(args...; kwargs...)` は同じ world-age-free wrapper へ lowering し、
  keyword-only / positional+keyword の代表ケースを本家と比較 fixture で固定した。
- upstream `destructure_callex` の `@invokelatest` property/index 代表形に合わせ、
  `@invokelatest x.f`, `@invokelatest x.f = v`, `@invokelatest xs[i]`,
  `@invokelatest xs[i] = v` を `getproperty` / `setproperty!` / `getindex` /
  `setindex!` 経由の `invokelatest` へ lower する。
- `invoke(f, Tuple{Number}, 2; y=5)` のような keyword 付き invoke は、指定 signature
  で method を選んだ後に `CallWithKwargs` で呼ぶようにした。
- `invoke(f, Tuple{Number}, x)` の `f` が引数で渡された Function value でも、
  static Tuple signature から `InvokeFunctionVariable` 経路に入り、runtime argument type ではなく
  指定 signature で method を選ぶ代表ケースを追加した。
- `sig` が関数引数として渡される runtime Tuple signature でも、
  `InvokeFunctionVariableDynamicSignature` が signature value から declared types を取り出し、
  `invoke(f, sig, x)` と `invoke(runtime_f, sig, x)` の代表ケースで指定 signature dispatch を行う。
- Function value 経由の keyword `invoke` も、static Tuple signature と runtime Tuple signature
  の両方で指定 signature dispatch 後に `bind_kwargs_with_map` を使って本家代表ケースに合わせる。
- keyword splat `invoke(...; kw...)` も `invoke` 専用 compile path に入り、通常 keyword-splat
  call と同じ展開後に指定 signature dispatch できる。
- upstream `julia/base/reflection.jl` の `macro invoke` と同様に、`@invoke f(x)` の
  unannotated positional argument は runtime `typeof(x)` を Tuple signature に入れる。
  `@invoke f(x::T; kw...)` も keyword / keyword-splat を保持して `invoke` に lower する。
- upstream `destructure_callex` の property/index 代表形に合わせ、
  `@invoke (x::X).f`, `@invoke (x::X).f = v::V`,
  `@invoke (xs::Xs)[i::I]`, `@invoke (xs::Xs)[i::I] = v::V` を
  `getproperty` / `setproperty!` / `getindex` / `setindex!` の declared-signature
  `invoke` に lower する。
- upstream `julia/base/reflection.jl` の doctest `@invoke 420::Integer % Unsigned`
  に合わせ、sjulia の `BinaryExpression` macro input は `%` を `rem` alias として
  declared-signature `invoke` に lower し、`base/int.jl` 側に integer type-conversion
  remainder の代表メソッドを追加した。
- `Base.get_world_counter()` / `Base.tls_world_age()` は single-world runtime の
  compatibility value として `UInt64(1)` を返し、`Base.invoke_in_world(world, f, args...;
  kwargs...)` は現時点の ordinary call wrapper として positional / vararg / keyword を転送する。
  ただし upstream で全 user method より古い world として扱われる `UInt64(0)` は、
  `Base.invoke_in_world(UInt64(0), f, args...)` で `MethodError` を投げる代表 boundary に合わせた。
- reflection world argument の代表ケースとして `hasmethod(f, types; world=w)`、
  `Base.return_types(f, types; world=w)`、`Core.Compiler.return_type(f, types, w)`、
  `Core.Compiler.return_type(Tuple{typeof(f), Args...}, w)` は single-world では現行 method
  table を使う互換動作に寄せる。
- upstream `./julia/base/essentials.jl` の `@world sym world` は `_resolve_in_world`
  経由で global binding を world-aware に解決する。sjulia は single-world runtime なので、
  identifier / dotted global function binding の代表ケースを現在 world の Function value として
  解決し、`(@world length Base.get_world_counter())([1,2,3]) == 3` を fixture で固定した。
- `@world` の展開結果を呼べるよう、parenthesized callable expression
  `(<function-valued expr>)(args...)` を indirect call に lower する。

### hasmethod keyword-name filtering (Issue #4292)

- upstream `hasmethod(f, Tuple{}, (:kw,))` は positional signature に加えて keyword name
  metadata で method existence を判定する。
- sjulia の `hasmethod` builtin を 3 引数 form まで受けるようにし、既存 `FunctionInfo.kwparams`
  metadata から named keyword と `kwargs...` varargs keyword acceptance を判定する。
- `kwargs...` の runtime `Pairs` value と `NamedTuple` keyword splat を既知関数への
  keyword splat で展開し、keyword forwarding の代表ケースを本家に合わせた。
- known-function call (`f(args...; kwargs...)`) と module-qualified call
  (`M.f(args...; kwargs...)`) でも `kwargs_splat_mask` を静的 method-table call /
  function-variable splat call に渡すようにし、function value / nested closure keyword
  splat、closure positional splat、callable struct keyword splat と合わせて
  metadata preservation の代表ケースを固定した。
- `hasmethod(f, Tuple{}, (:oranges,)) == true`,
  `hasmethod(f, Tuple{}, (:apples,)) == false`,
  `hasmethod(g, Tuple{}, (:a, :b)) == true` を fixture で固定した。

### runtime Array function-value dispatch (Issue #4295)

- `CallFunctionVariable` が使う runtime string-based subtype check に、compile-time
  `JuliaType` 側と同じ代表的な Array projection matching を追加した。
- これにより `Vector{Int64}` / `Matrix{Float64}` / `Array{Bool,3}` が
  `Array{T}` method signature に一致し、`f = getindex; f([10, 20], 2)` と
  `Base.invokelatest(getindex, [10, 20], 2)` が本家代表挙動と同じく `20` を返す。

### keyword-parameter arrow functions (Issue #4294)

- upstream `Meta.parse("(x; y=1) -> x + y")` と `julia/src/julia-syntax.scm`
  の arrow-lhs keyword argument lowering を確認した。
- pure Rust parser の parenthesized expression parsing で `;` を含む arrow parameter
  head を `ParameterList` として保持し、`(x; y=1) -> ...`、`(; y=1) -> ...`、
  `(args...; kwargs...) -> ...` を受理するようにした。
- lifted arrow lowering、short-form lambda assignment lowering、IIFE lowering の
  `Function.kwparams` を埋め、keyword defaults / `kwargs...` / positional varargs を
  ordinary function signature と同じ metadata で扱うようにした。
- keyword splat call と組み合わせた `c(1; kw...)`、`(x; kwargs...) -> c(x; kwargs...)`、
  `(args...; kwargs...) -> c(args...; kwargs...)`、`((x; y=10) -> x * y)(3; y=4)`
  を fixture で固定した。

### Val and NTuple value-parameter binding (Issue #4268)

- upstream `./julia/base/essentials.jl` の `Val{x}` / `Val(x)` と
  `NTuple{N,T}` alias の value-parameter binding を参照した。
- sjulia は `f(::Val{N}) where N = N` で `Val{3}()` と `Val(3)` の両方から
  `N == 3` を束縛し、`typeof(f(Val(3))) == Int64` になる。
- ordinary Float64 value parameters are now bound as runtime values too:
  `f(Val{1.5}()) == 1.5` and `typeof(f(Val{1.5}())) === Float64`, matching
  upstream Julia's value-parameter behavior for this representative bits value.
- Non-finite Float64 value parameters are covered as well:
  `Val{Inf}()`, `Val{-Inf}()`, and `Val{NaN}()` bind `N` as runtime
  `Float64` values.
- Simple Char value parameters are also bound as runtime values:
  `f(Val{'x'}()) == 'x'` and `typeof(f(Val{'x'}())) === Char`.
- Escaped Char value parameters use the same representative escape decoding as
  ordinary character literals, including newline, single quote, backslash, hex,
  and Unicode escapes.
- Tuple value parameters are covered for representative cases:
  `f(Val{(1, 2)}()) == (1, 2)`, `Val{()}()`, `Val{(1,)}()`,
  `Val{(true, :x)}()`, and nested tuple values bind `N` as a runtime tuple,
  matching upstream Julia's `Val{x}` value-parameter behavior.
- Constructor-form numeric bits value parameters now stay on the static `Val`
  path too: `Val{UInt8(1)}()`, `Val{Int32(2)}()`, and
  `Val{Float32(1.5)}()` bind `N` as runtime `UInt8`, `Int32`, and `Float32`
  values instead of being miscompiled as dynamic type construction.
- Typed constructor elements inside tuple value parameters are covered for the
  representative `Val{(UInt8(1), Int32(2))}()` case.
- `f_tuple(::Val{N}) where N = ntuple(i -> i, N)` は本家同様 `(1, 2, 3)` を返し、
  `ntuple` が callable に渡す添字も `Int64` として保持する。
- named callable 版の `ntuple(ident, 3)` も `(1, 2, 3)` / element `Int64` を維持する。
- `ntuple(i -> i + a, 3)` と、capturing arrow を local 変数 `f` に代入してから
  `ntuple(f, 3)` へ渡す代表ケースは、runtime callable path で closure captures を保持する。
  `Base.infer_return_type(..., Tuple{Int64})` も本家同様 `Tuple{Int64, Int64, Int64}` を返す。
- `h(xs::NTuple{N,T}) where {N,T}` は tuple runtime value から `N` と homogeneous
  element type `T` を束縛し、`h((1,2,3)) == 3` / `T == Int64` を fixture で固定した。

### global binding reassignment widening (Issue #4285)

- upstream `./julia/Compiler/src/bindinginvalidations.jl` が global binding 依存を
  invalidation 対象として扱うことを確認した。
- sjulia は world-age / binding partition をまだ持たないため、同じ top-level global が異なる
  storage type に再束縛された場合は `global_types` を `Any` に widen し、関数内参照を
  runtime load / dispatch に落とす代表互換を追加した。
